buildingDefs.Name: <link="ADVANCEDAPOTHECARY">Nuclear Apothecary</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Some medications help prevent diseases, while others aim to alleviate existing illness.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces <link="MEDICINE">Medicine</link> to cure most basic <link="DISEASE">Diseases</link>.

Duplicants must possess the Medicine Compounding <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to fabricate medicines.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: AdvancedApothecary

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ADVANCEDDOCTORSTATION">Disease Clinic</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Disease clinics require power, but treat more serious illnesses than sick bays alone.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to administer powerful treatments to sick Duplicants.

Duplicants must possess the Advanced Medical Care <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to treat peers.
buildingDefs.name: AdvancedDoctorStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ADVANCEDRESEARCHCENTER">Super Computer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Super computers unlock higher technology tiers than research stations alone.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Conducts <link="RESEARCH">Advanced Research</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes <link="WATER">Water</link>.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="RESEARCHING1">Advanced Research</link> skill.
buildingDefs.name: AdvancedResearchCenter

buildingDefs.Name: <link="AIRBORNECRITTERCONDO">Airborne Critter Condo</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Triggers natural nesting instincts and improves critters' moods.
buildingDefs.Effect: A hanging respite area for adult <link="PUFT">Pufts</link>, <link="MOOSPECIES">Gassy Moos</link> and <link="LIGHTBUG">Shine Bugs</link>.
buildingDefs.name: AirBorneCritterCondo

buildingDefs.Name: <link="AIRCONDITIONER">Thermo Regulator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A thermo regulator doesn't remove heat, but relocates it to a new area.
buildingDefs.Effect: Cools the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> piped through it, but outputs <link="HEAT">Heat</link> in its immediate vicinity.
buildingDefs.name: AirConditioner

buildingDefs.Name: <link="AIRFILTER">Deodorizer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Oh! Citrus scented!
buildingDefs.Effect: Uses <link="SAND">Sand</link> to filter <link="CONTAMINATEDOXYGEN">Polluted Oxygen</link> from the air, reducing <link="DISEASE">Disease</link> spread.
buildingDefs.name: AirFilter

buildingDefs.Name: <link="AIRBORNECREATURELURE">Airborne Critter Lure</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Lures can relocate Pufts or Shine Bugs to specific locations in my colony.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Attracts one type of airborne critter at a time.

Must be baited with <link="SLIMEMOLD">Slime</link> or <link="PHOSPHORITE">Phosphorite</link>.
buildingDefs.name: AirborneCreatureLure

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ALGAEDISTILLERY">Algae Distiller</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Algae distillers convert disease-causing slime into algae for oxygen production.
buildingDefs.Effect: Refines <link="SLIMEMOLD">Slime</link> into <link="ALGAE">Algae</link>.
buildingDefs.name: AlgaeDistillery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ALGAEHABITAT">Algae Terrarium</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Algae colony, Duplicant colony... we're more alike than we are different.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Consumes <link="ALGAE">Algae</link> to produce <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and remove some <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link>.

Gains a 10% efficiency boost in direct <link="LIGHT">Light</link>.
buildingDefs.name: AlgaeHabitat

buildingDefs.Name: <link="APOTHECARY">Apothecary</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Some medications help prevent diseases, while others aim to alleviate existing illness.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces <link="MEDICINE">Medicine</link> to cure most basic <link="DISEASE">Diseases</link>.

Duplicants must possess the Medicine Compounding <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to fabricate medicines.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: Apothecary

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ARCADEMACHINE">Arcade Cabinet</link>
buildingDefs.Desc:
Komet Kablam-O!
For up to two players.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to play video games on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: ArcadeMachine

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ARTIFACTANALYSISSTATION">Artifact Analysis Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Discover the mysteries of the past.
buildingDefs.Effect: Analyses and extracts <link="UNOBTANIUM">Neutronium</link> from artifacts of interest.
buildingDefs.name: ArtifactAnalysisStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ARTIFACTCARGOBAY">Artifact Transport Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Holds artifacts found in space.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to store any artifacts they uncover during space missions.

Artifacts become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: ArtifactCargoBay

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ASTRONAUTTRAININGCENTER">Space Cadet Centrifuge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants must complete astronaut training in order to pilot space rockets.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Trains Duplicants to become <link="ROCKETPILOTING1">Astronaut</link>.

Duplicants must possess the <link="ROCKETPILOTING1">Astronaut</link> trait to receive training.
buildingDefs.name: AstronautTrainingCenter

buildingDefs.Name: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.ATOMICGARDEN.NAME
buildingDefs.Desc: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.ATOMICGARDEN.DESC
buildingDefs.Effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.ATOMICGARDEN.EFFECT
buildingDefs.name: AtomicGarden

buildingDefs.Name: <link="AUTOMINER">Robo-Miner</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A robo-miner's range can be viewed at any time by selecting the building.
buildingDefs.Effect: Automatically digs out all materials in a set range.
buildingDefs.name: AutoMiner

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BATTERY">Battery</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Batteries allow power from generators to be stored for later.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="POWER">Power</link> from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Loses charge over time.
buildingDefs.name: Battery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BATTERYMEDIUM">Jumbo Battery</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Larger batteries hold more power and keep systems running longer before recharging.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="POWER">Power</link> from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Slightly loses charge over time.
buildingDefs.name: BatteryMedium

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BATTERYMODULE">Battery Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Charging a battery module before takeoff makes it easier to power buildings during flight.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores the excess <link="POWER">Power</link> generated by a Rocket Engine or <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

Provides stored power to <link="ROCKETINTERIORPOWERPLUG">Interior Rocket Outlets</link>.

Loses charge over time. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.
buildingDefs.name: BatteryModule

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when battery is less than Low Threshold charged, until High Threshold is reached again
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Sends a Red Signal when the battery is more than High Threshold charged, until Low Threshold is reached again

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BATTERYSMART">Smart Battery</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Smart batteries send a Green Signal when they require charging.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings. Sends a Green Signal or Red Signal based on the configuration of the Logic Activation Parameters. Very slightly loses charge over time.
buildingDefs.name: BatterySmart

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BEACHCHAIR">Beach Chair</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Soak up some relaxing sun rays.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Duplicants can relax by lounging in <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link>.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: BeachChair

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BED">Cot</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants without a bed will develop sore backs from sleeping on the floor.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Gives one Duplicant a place to sleep.

Duplicants will automatically return to their cots to sleep at night.
buildingDefs.name: Bed

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BIODIESELENGINECLUSTER">Biodiesel Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: More powerful rocket engines can propel heavier burdens.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Burns <link="REFINEDLIPID">Biodiesel</link> to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Biodiesel Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: BiodieselEngineCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIERCONDUITGAS">Canister Drainer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A canister drainer's Element Filter can designate areas for specific gas storage.
buildingDefs.Effect: Drains <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> canisters into <link="GASCONDUIT">Gas Pipes</link>.
buildingDefs.name: BottleEmptierConduitGas

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIERCONDUITLIQUID">Bottle Drainer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A bottle drainer's Element Filter can be used to designate areas for specific liquid storage.
buildingDefs.Effect: Drains bottled <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> into <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Liquid Pipes</link>.
buildingDefs.name: BottleEmptierConduitLiquid

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIER">Bottle Emptier</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A bottle emptier's Element Filter can be used to designate areas for specific liquid storage.
buildingDefs.Effect: Empties bottled <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> back into the world.
buildingDefs.name: BottleEmptier

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIERGAS">Canister Emptier</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A canister emptier's Element Filter can designate areas for specific gas storage.
buildingDefs.Effect: Empties <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> canisters back into the world.
buildingDefs.name: BottleEmptierGas

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BUNKERDOOR">Bunker Door</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A massive, slow-moving door which is nearly indestructible.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Can withstand extremely high pressures and impacts.
buildingDefs.name: BunkerDoor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="BUNKERTILE">Bunker Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Bunker tile can build strong shelters in otherwise dangerous environments.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Can withstand extreme pressures and impacts.
buildingDefs.name: BunkerTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CO2ENGINE">Carbon Dioxide Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses pressurized <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Carbon Dioxide Engines are relatively fast engine for their size but with limited height restrictions.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: CO2Engine

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CO2SCRUBBER">Carbon Skimmer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Skimmers remove large amounts of carbon dioxide, but produce no breathable air.
buildingDefs.Effect: Uses <link="WATER">Water</link> to filter <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> from the air.
buildingDefs.name: CO2Scrubber

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CANVAS">Blank Canvas</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Once built, a Duplicant can paint a blank canvas to produce a decorative painting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: Canvas

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CANVASTALL">Portrait Canvas</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Once built, a Duplicant can paint a blank canvas to produce a decorative painting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Moderately increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: CanvasTall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CANVASWIDE">Landscape Canvas</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Once built, a Duplicant can paint a blank canvas to produce a decorative painting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Moderately increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: CanvasWide

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CARPETTILE">Carpeted Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Soft on little Duplicant toesies.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: CarpetTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CEILINGLIGHT">Ceiling Light</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Light reduces Duplicant stress and is required to grow certain plants.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides <link="LIGHT">Light</link> when <link="POWER">Powered</link>.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.
buildingDefs.name: CeilingLight

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CHECKPOINT">Duplicant Checkpoint</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Checkpoints can be connected to automated sensors to determine when it's safe to enter.
buildingDefs.Effect: Allows Duplicants to pass when receiving a Green Signal. Prevents Duplicants from passing when receiving a Red Signal.
buildingDefs.name: Checkpoint

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CHEMICALREFINERY">Emulsifier</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It's like a blender, but better.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Combines <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> and other inputs into fluid compounds.

Duplicants will not fabricate emulsions unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: ChemicalRefinery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CHLORINATOR">Bleach Stone Hopper</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Bleach stone is useful for sanitation and geotuning.
buildingDefs.Effect: Uses <link="SALT">Salt</link> and <link="GOLD">Gold</link> to produce <link="BLEACHSTONE">Bleach Stone</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Chlorinator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CLOTHINGALTERATIONSTATION">Clothing Refashionator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Allows skilled Duplicants to add extra personal pizzazz to their wardrobe.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Upgrades <link="FUNKYVEST">Snazzy Suits</link> into <link="CUSTOMCLOTHING">Primo Garb</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: ClothingAlterationStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CLOTHINGFABRICATOR">Textile Loom</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A textile loom can be used to spin Reed Fiber into wearable Duplicant clothing.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Tailors Duplicant <link="EQUIPMENT">Clothing</link> items.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: ClothingFabricator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CLUSTERTELESCOPE">Telescope</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Telescopes are necessary for studying space, allowing rocket travel to other worlds.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space, producing <link="DATABANK">Data Banks</link> in the process.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="ASTRONOMY">Astronomy</link> skill.

Building must be exposed to space to function.
buildingDefs.name: ClusterTelescope

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CLUSTERTELESCOPEENCLOSED">Enclosed Telescope</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Telescopes are necessary for studying space, allowing rocket travel to other worlds.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space... in comfort!

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="ASTRONOMY">Astronomy</link> skill.

Excellent sunburn protection (100%), partial <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> protection (50%) .

Building must be exposed to space to function.
buildingDefs.name: ClusterTelescopeEnclosed

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if toggled ON
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Sends a Red Signal if toggled OFF

buildingDefs.Name: <link="COMETDETECTOR">Space Scanner</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Networks of many scanners will scan more efficiently than one on its own.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal to its automation circuit when it detects incoming objects from space. Can be configured to detect incoming meteor showers or returning space rockets.
buildingDefs.name: CometDetector

buildingDefs.Name: <link="COMPOST">Compost</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Composts safely deal with biological waste, producing fresh dirt.
buildingDefs.Effect: Reduces <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link>, rotting <link="FOOD">Foods</link>, and discarded organics down into <link="DIRT">Dirt</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Compost

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs in the pipe is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUITDISEASESENSOR">Gas Pipe Germ Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduitDiseaseSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs in the pipe is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITDISEASESENSOR">Liquid Pipe Germ Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduitDiseaseSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the configured Gas is detected

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUITELEMENTSENSOR">Gas Pipe Element Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific gas in a pipe.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected within a pipe.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduitElementSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the configured Liquid is detected within the pipe

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITELEMENTSENSOR">Liquid Pipe Element Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific liquid in a pipe.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected within a pipe.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduitElementSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the contained Gas is within the selected Temperature range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUITTEMPERATURESENSOR">Gas Pipe Thermo Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their pipe contents reach a certain temperature.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduitTemperatureSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the contained Liquid is within the selected Temperature range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITTEMPERATURESENSOR">Liquid Pipe Thermo Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their pipe contents reach a certain temperature.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduitTemperatureSensor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CONTACTCONDUCTIVEPIPEBRIDGE">Conduction Panel</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It can transfer heat effectively even if no liquid is passing through.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, allowing extreme <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange with overlapping buildings.

Can function in a vacuum.

Can be run through wall and floor tiles.
buildingDefs.name: ContactConductivePipeBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="COOKINGSTATION">Electric Grill</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Proper cooking eliminates foodborne disease and produces tasty, stress-relieving meals.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Cooks a wide variety of improved <link="FOOD">Foods</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: CookingStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CORNERMOULDING">Corner Trim</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Corner trim is a purely decorative addition for ceiling corners.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to decorate the ceiling corners of rooms.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: CornerMoulding

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CRAFTINGTABLE">Crafting Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Crafting stations allow Duplicants to make oxygen masks to wear in low breathability areas.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces items and equipment for Duplicant use.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: CraftingTable

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CREATUREDELIVERYPOINT">Critter Drop-Off</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants automatically bring captured critters to these relocation points for release.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Releases trapped <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> back into the world.

Can be used multiple times.
buildingDefs.name: CreatureDeliveryPoint

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CREATUREFEEDER">Critter Feeder</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Critters tend to stay close to their food source and wander less when given a feeder.
buildingDefs.Effect: Automatically dispenses food for hungry <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.
buildingDefs.name: CreatureFeeder

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CREATURETRAP">Critter Trap</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Critter traps cannot catch swimming or flying critters.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Captures a living <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> for transport.

Single use.
buildingDefs.name: CreatureTrap

buildingDefs.Name: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.CREWCAPSULE.NAME
buildingDefs.Desc: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.CREWCAPSULE.DESC
buildingDefs.Effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.CREWCAPSULE.EFFECT
buildingDefs.name: CrewCapsule

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CRITTERCONDO">Critter Condo</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It's nice to have nice things.
buildingDefs.Effect: Provides a comfortable lounge area that boosts <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> happiness.
buildingDefs.name: CritterCondo

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CRITTERDROPOFF">Critter Drop-Off</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants automatically bring captured critters to these relocation points for release.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Releases trapped <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> back into the world.

Monitoring and drop-off are limited to the specified species.
buildingDefs.name: CritterDropOff

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CRITTERPICKUP">Critter Pick-Up</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants will automatically wrangle excess critters.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Ensures the prompt relocation of <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> that exceed the maximum amount set.

Monitoring and pick-up are limited to the specified species.
buildingDefs.name: CritterPickUp

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CROWNMOULDING">Ceiling Trim</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Ceiling trim is a purely decorative addition to one's overhead area.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to decorate the ceilings of rooms.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: CrownMoulding

buildingDefs.Name: <link="DLC1COSMICRESEARCHCENTER">Virtual Planetarium</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Planetariums allow the simulated exploration of locations recorded in <link="ORBITALRESEARCHDATABANK">Data Banks</link>.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Conducts <link="RESEARCH">Data Analysis Research</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes <link="ORBITALRESEARCHDATABANK">Data Banks</link> generated by exploration.
buildingDefs.name: DLC1CosmicResearchCenter

buildingDefs.Name: <link="DECONTAMINATIONSHOWER">Decontamination Shower</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Don't forget to decontaminate behind your ears.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses <link="WATER">Water</link> to remove <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> and <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link>.

Decontaminates both Duplicants and their <link="EQUIPMENT">Clothing</link>.
buildingDefs.name: DecontaminationShower

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Generator
buildingDefs.Desc: Runs on coffee.
buildingDefs.Effect: Generates testing power for late nights.
buildingDefs.name: DevGenerator

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Radbolt Generator
buildingDefs.Desc: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
buildingDefs.Effect: Generates Radbolts.
buildingDefs.name: DevHEPSpawner

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Heater
buildingDefs.Desc: Did someone touch the thermostat?
buildingDefs.Effect: Generates on-demand heat for testing toastiness.
buildingDefs.name: DevHeater

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Life Support
buildingDefs.Desc: Keeps Duplicants cozy and breathing.
buildingDefs.Effect: Generates warm, oxygen-rich air.
buildingDefs.name: DevLifeSupport

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Light Source
buildingDefs.Desc: Brightens up a dev's darkest hours.
buildingDefs.Effect: Generates dimmable light on demand.
buildingDefs.name: DevLightGenerator

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Pump Gas
buildingDefs.Desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send gas to that building.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and runs it through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be immersed in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.
buildingDefs.name: DevPumpGas

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Pump Liquid
buildingDefs.Desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send liquid to that building.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and runs it through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.
buildingDefs.name: DevPumpLiquid

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Pump Solid
buildingDefs.Desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send solids to that building.
buildingDefs.Effect: Generates chosen <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> and runs it through <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link>
buildingDefs.name: DevPumpSolid

buildingDefs.Name: Dev Radiation Emitter
buildingDefs.Desc: That's some strong coffee.
buildingDefs.Effect: Generates on-demand radiation to keep things clear. Nu-clear.
buildingDefs.name: DevRadiationGenerator

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

buildingDefs.Name: <link="DIAMONDPRESS">Diamond Press</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Crushes refined carbon into diamond.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses <link="POWER">Power</link> and <link="RADIATION">Radbolts</link> to crush <link="REFINEDCARBON">Refined Carbon</link> into <link="DIAMOND">Diamond</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued and <link="REFINEDCARBON">Refined Carbon</link> has been discovered.
buildingDefs.name: DiamondPress

buildingDefs.Name: <link="DININGTABLE">Mess Table</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants prefer to dine at a table, rather than eat off the floor.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Gives one Duplicant a place to eat.

Duplicants will automatically eat at their assigned table when hungry.
buildingDefs.name: DiningTable

buildingDefs.Name: <link="DOCTORSTATION">Sick Bay</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Sick bays can be placed in hospital rooms to decrease the likelihood of disease spreading.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to administer basic treatments to sick Duplicants.

Duplicants must possess the Bedside Manner <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to treat peers.
buildingDefs.name: DoctorStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="DOOR">Pneumatic Door</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Door controls can be used to prevent Duplicants from entering restricted areas.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Encloses areas without blocking <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> or <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow.

Wild <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> cannot pass through doors.
buildingDefs.name: Door

buildingDefs.Name: <link="EGGCRACKER">Egg Cracker</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Raw eggs are an ingredient in certain high quality food recipes.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts viable <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> eggs into cooking ingredients.

Cracked Eggs cannot hatch.

Duplicants will not crack eggs unless tasks are queued.
buildingDefs.name: EggCracker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="EGGINCUBATOR">Incubator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Incubators can maintain the ideal internal conditions for several species of critter egg.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Incubates <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> eggs until ready to hatch.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching</link> skill.
buildingDefs.name: EggIncubator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ELECTROLYZER">Electrolyzer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Water goes in one end, life sustaining oxygen comes out the other.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts <link="WATER">Water</link> into <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and <link="HYDROGEN">Hydrogen Gas</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.
buildingDefs.name: Electrolyzer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ESPRESSOMACHINE">Espresso Machine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A shot of espresso helps Duplicants relax after a long day.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: EspressoMachine

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ETHANOLDISTILLERY">Ethanol Distiller</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Ethanol distillers convert <link="WOOD">Wood</link> into burnable <link="ETHANOL">Ethanol</link> fuel.
buildingDefs.Effect: Refines <link="WOOD">Wood</link> into <link="ETHANOL">Ethanol</link>.
buildingDefs.name: EthanolDistillery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="EXOBASEHEADQUARTERS">Mini-Pod</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A quick and easy substitute, though it'll never live up to the original.
buildingDefs.Effect:
A portable bioprinter that produces new Duplicants or care packages containing resources.

Only one Printing Pod or Mini-Pod is permitted per Planetoid.
buildingDefs.name: ExobaseHeadquarters

buildingDefs.Name: <link="EXTERIORWALL">Drywall</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Drywall can be used in conjunction with tiles to build airtight rooms on the surface.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Prevents <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> loss in space.

Builds an insulating backwall behind buildings.
buildingDefs.name: ExteriorWall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FABRICATEDWOODMAKER">Plywood Press</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Flattened plant bits are a useful wood substitute.
buildingDefs.Effect: Combines a Binder liquid and <link="PLANTFIBER">Plant Husk</link> to create <link="FABRICATEDWOOD">Plywood</link>.
buildingDefs.name: FabricatedWoodMaker

buildingDefs.Name: Window
buildingDefs.Effect: A tall, thin window.
buildingDefs.name: FacilityBackWallWindow

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FARMSTATION">Farm Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: This station only has an effect on crops grown within the same room.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces <link="FARMSTATIONTOOLS">Micronutrient Fertilizer</link> to increase <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> growth rates.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="FARMING2">Crop Tending</link> trait.

This building is a necessary component of the Greenhouse room.
buildingDefs.name: FarmStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FARMTILE">Farm Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants can deliver fertilizer and liquids to farm tiles, accelerating plant growth.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Grows one <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: FarmTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FERTILIZERMAKER">Fertilizer Synthesizer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Fertilizer synthesizers convert polluted dirt into fertilizer for domestic plants.
buildingDefs.Effect: Uses <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link> and <link="PHOSPHORITE">Phosphorite</link> to produce <link="FERTILIZER">Fertilizer</link>.
buildingDefs.name: FertilizerMaker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FIREPOLE">Fire Pole</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Build these in addition to ladders for efficient upward and downward movement.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows rapid Duplicant descent.

Significantly slows upward climbing.
buildingDefs.name: FirePole

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FISHDELIVERYPOINT">Fish Release</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A fish release must be built in liquid to prevent released fish from suffocating.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Releases trapped <link="PACU">Pacu</link> back into the world.

Can be used multiple times.
buildingDefs.name: FishDeliveryPoint

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FISHFEEDER">Fish Feeder</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Build this feeder above a body of water to feed the fish within.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Automatically dispenses stored <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> food into the area below.

Dispenses continuously as food is consumed.
buildingDefs.name: FishFeeder

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FISHTRAP">Fish Trap</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Trapped fish will automatically be bagged for transport.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Attracts and traps swimming <link="PACU">Pacu</link>.

Single use.
buildingDefs.name: FishTrap

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLOORLAMP">Lamp</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Any building's light emitting radius can be viewed in the light overlay.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides <link="LIGHT">Light</link> when <link="POWER">Powered</link>.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.
buildingDefs.name: FloorLamp

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if toggled ON
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Sends a Red Signal if toggled OFF

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLOORSWITCH">Weight Plate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Weight plates can be used to turn on amenities only when Duplicants pass by.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal when an object or Duplicant is placed atop of it. Cannot be triggered by Gas or Liquids.
buildingDefs.name: FloorSwitch

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLOWERVASE">Flower Pot</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Flower pots allow decorative plants to be moved to new locations.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> when in use, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: FlowerVase

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLOWERVASEHANGING">Hanging Pot</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Hanging pots can add some Decor to a room, without blocking buildings on the floor.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> when in use, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be hung from a ceiling.
buildingDefs.name: FlowerVaseHanging

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLOWERVASEHANGINGFANCY">Aero Pot</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Aero pots can be hung from the ceiling and have extremely high Decor.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> even when empty, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be hung from a ceiling.
buildingDefs.name: FlowerVaseHangingFancy

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLOWERVASEWALL">Wall Pot</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Placing a plant in a wall pot can add a spot of Decor to otherwise bare walls.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> when in use, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be hung from a wall.
buildingDefs.name: FlowerVaseWall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLUSHTOILET">Lavatory</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Lavatories transmit fewer germs to Duplicants' skin and require no emptying.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves.

Spreads very few <link="DISEASE">Germs</link>.
buildingDefs.name: FlushToilet

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FLYINGCREATUREBAIT">Airborne Critter Bait</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The type of critter attracted by critter bait depends on the construction material.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Attracts one type of airborne critter.

Single use.
buildingDefs.name: FlyingCreatureBait

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FOODDEHYDRATOR">Dehydrator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Some of the eliminated liquid inevitably ends up on the floor.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses low, even heat to eliminate moisture from eligible <link="FOOD">Foods</link> and render them shelf-stable.

Dehydrated meals must be processed at the <link="FOODREHYDRATOR">Rehydrator</link> before they can be eaten.
buildingDefs.name: FoodDehydrator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="FOODREHYDRATOR">Rehydrator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rehydrated food is nutritious and only slightly less delicious.
buildingDefs.Effect: Restores moisture to convert shelf-stable packaged meals into edible <link="FOOD">Food</link>.
buildingDefs.name: FoodRehydrator

buildingDefs.Name: Ancient Specimen
buildingDefs.Desc: It's not from around here.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Contains a partial <link="FOSSIL">Fossil</link> left behind by a giant critter.

Studying the full skeleton could yield the information required to access a valuable new resource.
buildingDefs.name: FossilDig

LogicInputPorts.activeDescription: Extends gantry when a Green Signal signal is received
LogicInputPorts.inactiveDescription: Retracts gantry when a Red Signal signal is received

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GANTRY">Gantry</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A gantry can be built over rocket pieces where ladders and tile cannot.
buildingDefs.Effect: Provides scaffolding across rocket modules to allow Duplicant access.
buildingDefs.name: Gantry

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASBOTTLER">Canister Filler</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Canisters allow Duplicants to manually deliver gases from place to place.
buildingDefs.Effect: Automatically stores piped <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> into canisters for manual transport.
buildingDefs.name: GasBottler

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCARGOBAYCLUSTER">Large Gas Cargo Canister</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Holds more than a typical gas cargo canister.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to store most of the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasCargoBayCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCARGOBAYSMALL">Gas Cargo Canister</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants fill cargo canisters with any resources they find during space missions.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to store some of the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasCargoBaySmall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUITBRIDGE">Gas Bridge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Separate pipe systems prevent mingled contents from causing building damage.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Runs one <link="GASPIPING">Gas Pipe</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduitBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUIT">Gas Pipe</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Gas pipes are used to connect the inputs and outputs of ventilated buildings.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> between <link="GASPIPING">Outputs</link> and <link="GASPIPING">Intakes</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUITOVERFLOW">Gas Overflow Valve</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Overflow valves can be used to prioritize which buildings should receive precious resources first.
buildingDefs.Effect: Fills a secondary<link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> output only when its primary output is blocked.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduitOverflow

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUITPREFERENTIALFLOW">Priority Gas Flow</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Priority flows ensure important buildings are filled first when on a system with other buildings.
buildingDefs.Effect: Diverts <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> to a secondary input when its primary input overflows.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduitPreferentialFlow

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASCONDUITRADIANT">Radiant Gas Pipe</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radiant pipes pumping cold gas can be run through hot areas to help cool them down.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>, allowing extreme <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: GasConduitRadiant

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASFILTER">Gas Filter</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: All gases are sent into the building's output pipe, except the gas chosen for filtering.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sieves one <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> from the air, sending it into a dedicated <link="GASPIPING">Pipe</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasFilter

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if limit has been reached

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASLIMITVALVE">Gas Meter Valve</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Meter Valves let an exact amount of gas pass through before shutting off.
buildingDefs.Effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow off when the specified amount has passed through it.
buildingDefs.name: GasLimitValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASLOGICVALVE">Gas Shutoff</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Automated piping saves power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
buildingDefs.Effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow on or off.
buildingDefs.name: GasLogicValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASMINIPUMP">Mini Gas Pump</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Mini pumps are useful for moving small quantities of gas with minimum power.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Draws in a small amount of <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and runs it through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be immersed in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasMiniPump

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASPERMEABLEMEMBRANE">Airflow Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Building with airflow tile promotes better gas circulation within a colony.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> flow without obstructing <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasPermeableMembrane

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASPUMP">Gas Pump</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send gas to that building.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and runs it through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be immersed in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasPump

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when reservoir is less than Low Threshold full, until High Threshold is reached again
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Sends a Red Signal when reservoir is High Threshold full, until Low Threshold is reached again

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASRESERVOIR">Gas Reservoir</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Reservoirs cannot receive manually delivered resources.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores any <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources piped into it.
buildingDefs.name: GasReservoir

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASVALVE">Gas Valve</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Valves control the amount of gas that moves through pipes, preventing waste.
buildingDefs.Effect: Controls the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> volume permitted through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASVENT">Gas Vent</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Vents are an exit point for gases from ventilation systems.
buildingDefs.Effect: Releases <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> from <link="GASPIPING">Gas Pipes</link>.
buildingDefs.name: GasVent

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GASVENTHIGHPRESSURE">High Pressure Gas Vent</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: High pressure vents can expel gas into more highly pressurized environments.
buildingDefs.Effect: Releases <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> from <link="GASPIPING">Gas Pipes</link> into high pressure locations.
buildingDefs.name: GasVentHighPressure

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GENERATOR">Coal Generator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Burning coal produces more energy than manual power, but emits heat and exhaust.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts <link="CARBON">Coal</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Generator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GENERICFABRICATOR">Omniprinter</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Omniprinters are incapable of printing organic matter.
buildingDefs.Effect: Converts <link="RAWMINERAL">Raw Mineral</link> into unique materials and objects.
buildingDefs.name: GenericFabricator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GENETICANALYSISSTATION">Botanical Analyzer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Would a mutated rose still smell as sweet?
buildingDefs.Effect: Identifies new <link="PLANTS">Seed</link> subspecies.
buildingDefs.name: GeneticAnalysisStation

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when geyser is erupting

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GEOTUNER">Geotuner</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The targeted geyser receives stored amplification data when it is erupting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Increases the <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> and output of an analyzed <link="GEYSERS">Geyser</link>.

Multiple Geotuners can be directed at a single <link="GEYSERS">Geyser</link> anywhere on an asteroid.
buildingDefs.name: GeoTuner

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GLASSFORGE">Glass Forge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Glass can be used to construct window tile.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces <link="MOLTENGLASS">Molten Glass</link> from raw <link="SAND">Sand</link>.

Outputs <link="HEAT">High Temperature</link> <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: GlassForge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GLASSTILE">Window Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Window tiles provide a barrier against liquid and gas and are completely transparent.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Allows <link="LIGHT">Light</link> and <link="DECOR">Decor</link> to pass through.
buildingDefs.name: GlassTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GOURMETCOOKINGSTATION">Gas Range</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Luxury meals increase Duplicants' morale and prevent them from becoming stressed.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Cooks a wide variety of quality <link="FOOD">Foods</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: GourmetCookingStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GRAVE">Tasteful Memorial</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Burying dead Duplicants reduces health hazards and stress on the colony.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides a final resting place for deceased Duplicants.

Living Duplicants will automatically place an unburied corpse inside.
buildingDefs.name: Grave

buildingDefs.Name: Toilet
buildingDefs.Effect:
A private toilet for senior scientists.

It was the site of many great scientific breakthroughs.
buildingDefs.name: GravitasBathroomStall

buildingDefs.Name: Pajama Cubby
buildingDefs.Effect:
A clothing storage unit.

It contains ultra-soft sleepwear.
buildingDefs.name: GravitasContainer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="GRAVITASCREATUREMANIPULATOR">Critter Flux-O-Matic</link>
buildingDefs.Effect:
An experimental DNA manipulator.

Analyzes <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> to transform base morphs into random variants of their species.
buildingDefs.name: GravitasCreatureManipulator

buildingDefs.Name: Gravitas Door
buildingDefs.Effect: An office door to an office that no longer exists.
buildingDefs.name: GravitasDoor

buildingDefs.Name: LED Light
buildingDefs.Effect: An overhead light therapy lamp designed to soothe the minds.
buildingDefs.name: GravitasLabLight

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ITEMPEDESTAL">Gravitas Pedestal</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Perception can be drastically changed by a bit of thoughtful presentation.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Displays a single object, doubling its <link="DECOR">Decor</link> value.

Objects with negative Decor will gain some positive Decor when displayed.
buildingDefs.name: GravitasPedestal

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HEPBATTERY">Radbolt Chamber</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Particles packed up and ready to go.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores Radbolts in a high-energy state, ready for transport. Requires a Green Signal to release radbolts from storage when the Radbolt threshold is reached. Radbolts in storage will rapidly decay while this building is disabled.
buildingDefs.name: HEPBattery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HEPBRIDGETILE">Radbolt Joint Plate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Allows Radbolts to pass through walls.
buildingDefs.Effect: Receives <link="RADIATION">Radbolts</link> from <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generators</link> and directs them through walls. All other materials and elements will be blocked from passage.
buildingDefs.name: HEPBridgeTile

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HEPENGINE">Radbolt Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radbolt-fueled rockets support few modules, but travel exceptionally far.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Injects <link="RADIATION">Radbolts</link> into a reaction chamber to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Radbolt Engines are faster than <link="HYDROGENENGINE">Hydrogen Engines</link> but with a more restrictive height allowance.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: HEPEngine

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Allows Duplicants to survive space travel... Hopefully.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Functions as a Command Module.

Holds up to 10 Duplicant travellers.

One Command Module may be installed per rocket. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: HabitatModuleMedium

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HABITATMODULESMALL">Solo Spacefarer Nosecone</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: One lucky Duplicant gets the best view from the whole rocket.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Functions as a Command Module and a Nosecone.

Holds one Duplicant traveller.

One Command Module may be installed per rocket.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Must be built at the top of a rocket.
buildingDefs.name: HabitatModuleSmall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HANDSANITIZER">Hand Sanitizer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Hand sanitizers kill germs more effectively than wash basins.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Removes most <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Hand Sanitizers when passing by in the selected direction.
buildingDefs.name: HandSanitizer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HEADQUARTERS">Printing Pod</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: New Duplicants come out here, but thank goodness, they never go back in.
buildingDefs.Effect:
An exceptionally advanced bioprinter of unknown origin.

It periodically produces new Duplicants or care packages containing resources.
buildingDefs.name: Headquarters

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HEATCOMPRESSOR">Liquid Heatquilizer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: "Room temperature" is relative, really.
buildingDefs.Effect: Heats or cools <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> to match ambient <link="HEAT">Air Temperature</link>.
buildingDefs.name: HeatCompressor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLEREDIRECTOR">Radbolt Reflector</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: We were all out of mirrors.
buildingDefs.Effect: Receives and redirects Radbolts from <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generators</link>.
buildingDefs.name: HighEnergyParticleRedirector

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Attracts nearby <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of your choosing when the set Radbolt threshold is reached.

Radbolts collected will gradually decay while this building is disabled.
buildingDefs.name: HighEnergyParticleSpawner

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HIJACKEDHEADQUARTERS">Printerceptor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The access code required to reboot it for testing is located somewhere on this world.
buildingDefs.Effect: An unsanctioned bioprinter that runs on power siphoned from the <link="HEADQUARTERS">Printing Pod</link>.
buildingDefs.name: HijackedHeadquarters

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HOTTUB">Hot Tub</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Relaxes Duplicants with massaging jets of heated liquid.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Requires <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link> to and from tub and <link="POWER">Power</link> to run the jets.

Water must be a comfortable temperature and will cool rapidly.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link> and leaves them feeling deliciously warm.
buildingDefs.name: HotTub

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HYDROGENENGINECLUSTER">Hydrogen Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Hydrogen engines can propel rockets further than steam or petroleum engines.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Burns <link="LIQUIDHYDROGEN">Liquid Hydrogen</link> to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Hydrogen Engines have the same generous height restrictions as <link="KEROSENEENGINE">Petroleum Engines</link> but are slightly faster.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: HydrogenEngineCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HYDROGENGENERATOR">Hydrogen Generator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Hydrogen generators are extremely efficient, emitting next to no waste.
buildingDefs.Effect: Converts <link="HYDROGEN">Hydrogen Gas</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.
buildingDefs.name: HydrogenGenerator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HYDROPONICFARM">Hydroponic Farm</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Hydroponic farms reduce Duplicant traffic by automating irrigating crops.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Grows one <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

Must be irrigated through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Piping</link>.
buildingDefs.name: HydroponicFarm

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ICECOOLEDFAN">Ice-E Fan</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A Duplicant can work an Ice-E fan to temporarily cool small areas as needed.
buildingDefs.Effect: Uses <link="ICEORE">Ice</link> to dissipate a small amount of the <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.
buildingDefs.name: IceCooledFan

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ICEMACHINE">Ice Maker</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Ice makers can be used as a small renewable source of ice and snow.
buildingDefs.Effect: Converts <link="WATER">Water</link> into <link="ICE">Ice</link> or <link="SNOW">Snow</link>.
buildingDefs.name: IceMachine

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ICESCULPTURE">Ice Block</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Prone to melting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: IceSculpture

buildingDefs.Name: <link="INSULATEDGASCONDUIT">Insulated Gas Pipe</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Pipe insulation prevents gas contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> with minimal change in <link="HEAT">Temperature</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: InsulatedGasConduit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="INSULATEDLIQUIDCONDUIT">Insulated Liquid Pipe</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Pipe insulation prevents liquid contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> with minimal change in <link="HEAT">Temperature</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: InsulatedLiquidConduit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="INSULATIONTILE">Insulated Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The low thermal conductivity of insulated tiles slows any heat passing through them.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Reduces <link="HEAT">Heat</link> transfer between walls, retaining ambient heat in an area.
buildingDefs.name: InsulationTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ITEMPEDESTAL">Pedestal</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Perception can be drastically changed by a bit of thoughtful presentation.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Displays a single object, doubling its <link="DECOR">Decor</link> value.

Objects with negative Decor will gain some positive Decor when displayed.
buildingDefs.name: ItemPedestal

buildingDefs.Name: <link="JETSUITLOCKER">Jet Suit Dock</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Jet suit docks can refill jet suits with air and fuel, or empty them of waste.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="JETSUIT">Jet Suits</link> and refuels them with <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and <link="COMBUSTIBLELIQUID">Combustible Liquid</link>.

Empties suits of <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

Build next to a <link="JETSUITMARKER">Jet Suit Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.
buildingDefs.name: JetSuitLocker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="JETSUITMARKER">Jet Suit Checkpoint</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of <link="JETSUIT">Jet Suits</link>.

Must be built next to a <link="JETSUITLOCKER">Jet Suit Dock</link>.

Can be rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: JetSuitMarker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="JUICER">Juicer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Fruity juice can really brighten a Duplicant's breaktime
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Drinking juice increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Juicer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="KEROSENEENGINECLUSTER">Petroleum Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: More powerful rocket engines can propel heavier burdens.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Burns <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link> to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Petroleum Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: KeroseneEngineCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="KEROSENEENGINECLUSTERSMALL">Small Petroleum Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Burns <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link> to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Small Petroleum Engines possess the same speed as a <link="KEROSENEENGINE">Petroleum Engines</link> but have smaller height restrictions.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: KeroseneEngineClusterSmall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="KILN">Kiln</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It gets quite hot.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Fires <link="CLAY">Clay</link> to produce <link="CERAMIC">Ceramic</link>, and <link="CARBON">Coal</link> or <link="WOOD">Wood</link> to produce <link="REFINEDCARBON">Refined Carbon</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: Kiln

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LADDERBED">Ladder Bed</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicant's sleep will be interrupted if another Duplicant uses the ladder.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides a sleeping area for one Duplicant and also functions as a ladder.

Duplicants will automatically sleep in their assigned beds at night.
buildingDefs.name: LadderBed

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LADDER">Ladder</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: (That means they climb it.)
buildingDefs.Effect: Enables vertical mobility for Duplicants.
buildingDefs.name: Ladder

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LADDERFAST">Plastic Ladder</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Plastic ladders are mildly antiseptic and can help limit the spread of germs in a colony.
buildingDefs.Effect: Increases Duplicant climbing speed.
buildingDefs.name: LadderFast

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LANDINGBEACON">Targeting Beacon</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Microtarget where your <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payload</link> lands on a Planetoid surface.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Guides <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> and <link="ORBITALCARGOMODULE">Orbital Cargo Modules</link> to land nearby.

<link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> must be launched from a <link="RAILGUN">Interplanetary Launcher</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LandingBeacon

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when its rocket is ready for flight
Sends a Green Signal when its rocket is on the <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A platform from which rockets can be launched and on which they can land.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Precursor to construction of all other Rocket modules.

Allows Rockets to launch from or land on the host Planetoid.

Automatically links up to <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link><link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">s</link> built to either side of the platform.
buildingDefs.name: LaunchPad

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LEADSUITLOCKER">Lead Suit Dock</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Lead suit docks can refill lead suits with air and empty them of waste.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="LEADSUIT">Lead Suits</link> and refuels them with <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Empties suits of <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

Build next to a <link="LEADSUITMARKER">Lead Suit Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.
buildingDefs.name: LeadSuitLocker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LEADSUITMARKER">Lead Suit Checkpoint</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of <link="LEADSUIT">Lead Suits</link>.

Must be built next to a <link="LEADSUITLOCKER">Lead Suit Dock</link>

Can be rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: LeadSuitMarker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDBOTTLER">Bottle Filler</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Bottle fillers allow Duplicants to manually deliver liquids from place to place.
buildingDefs.Effect: Automatically stores piped <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> into bottles for manual transport.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidBottler

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCARGOBAYCLUSTER">Large Liquid Cargo Tank</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Holds more than a regular cargo tank.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to store most of the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidCargoBayCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCARGOBAYSMALL">Liquid Cargo Tank</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants will fill cargo tanks with whatever resources they find during space missions.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to store some of the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidCargoBaySmall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDITIONER">Thermo Aquatuner</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A thermo aquatuner cools liquid and outputs the heat elsewhere.
buildingDefs.Effect: Cools the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> piped through it, but outputs <link="HEAT">Heat</link> in its immediate vicinity.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConditioner

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITBRIDGE">Liquid Bridge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Separate pipe systems help prevent building damage caused by mingled pipe contents.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Runs one <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Pipe</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduitBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Liquid Pipe</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Liquid pipes are used to connect the inputs and outputs of plumbed buildings.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> between <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Outputs</link> and <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Intakes</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITOVERFLOW">Liquid Overflow Valve</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Overflow valves can be used to prioritize which buildings should receive precious resources first.
buildingDefs.Effect: Fills a secondary<link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> output only when its primary output is blocked.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduitOverflow

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITPREFERENTIALFLOW">Priority Liquid Flow</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Priority flows ensure important buildings are filled first when on a system with other buildings.
buildingDefs.Effect: Diverts <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> to a secondary input when its primary input overflows.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduitPreferentialFlow

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITRADIANT">Radiant Liquid Pipe</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radiant pipes pumping cold liquid can be run through hot areas to help cool them down.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, allowing extreme <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidConduitRadiant

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDCOOLEDFAN">Hydrofan</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A Duplicant can work a hydrofan to temporarily cool small areas as needed.
buildingDefs.Effect: Dissipates a small amount of the <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidCooledFan

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDFILTER">Liquid Filter</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: All liquids are sent into the building's output pipe, except the liquid chosen for filtering.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Sieves one <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> out of a mix, sending it into a dedicated <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Filtered Output Pipe</link>.

Can only filter one liquid type at a time.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidFilter

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDFUELTANKCLUSTER">Large Liquid Fuel Tank</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Storing additional fuel increases the distance a rocket can travel before returning.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> fuel piped into it to supply rocket engines.

The stored fuel type is determined by the rocket engine it is built upon. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidFuelTankCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDHEATER">Liquid Tepidizer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Tepidizers heat liquid which can kill waterborne germs.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Warms large bodies of <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

Must be fully submerged.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidHeater

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if limit has been reached

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDLIMITVALVE">Liquid Meter Valve</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Meter Valves let an exact amount of liquid pass through before shutting off.
buildingDefs.Effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> flow off when the specified amount has passed through it.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidLimitValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDLOGICVALVE">Liquid Shutoff</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Automated piping saves power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
buildingDefs.Effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> flow on or off.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidLogicValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDMINIPUMP">Mini Liquid Pump</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Mini pumps are useful for moving small quantities of liquid with minimum power.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Draws in a small amount of <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and runs it through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidMiniPump

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDPUMP">Liquid Pump</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send liquid to that building.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and runs it through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidPump

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDPUMPINGSTATION">Pitcher Pump</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Pitcher pumps allow Duplicants to bottle and deliver liquids from place to place.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Manually pumps <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> into bottles for transport.

Duplicants can only carry liquids that are bottled.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidPumpingStation

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when reservoir is less than Low Threshold full, until High Threshold is reached again
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Sends a Red Signal when reservoir is High Threshold full, until Low Threshold is reached again

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDRESERVOIR">Liquid Reservoir</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Reservoirs cannot receive manually delivered resources.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores any <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> resources piped into it.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidReservoir

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDVALVE">Liquid Valve</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Valves control the amount of liquid that moves through pipes, preventing waste.
buildingDefs.Effect: Controls the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> volume permitted through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LIQUIDVENT">Liquid Vent</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Vents are an exit point for liquids from plumbing systems.
buildingDefs.Effect: Releases <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> from <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Pipes</link>.
buildingDefs.name: LiquidVent

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICALARM">Automated Notifier</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Sends a notification when it receives a Green Signal.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Attach to sensors to send a notification when certain conditions are met.

Notifications can be customized.
buildingDefs.name: LogicAlarm

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signalwhen a spacecraft is at the chosen Starmap locations

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICCLUSTERLOCATIONSENSOR">Starmap Location Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Starmap Location sensors can signal when a spacecraft is at a certain location
buildingDefs.Effect: Send Green Signals at the chosen Starmap locations and Red Signals everywhere else.
buildingDefs.name: LogicClusterLocationSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when the counter matches the selected value

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICCOUNTER">Signal Counter</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: For numbers higher than ten connect multiple counters together.
buildingDefs.Effect: Counts how many times a Green Signal has been received up to a chosen number. When the chosen number is reached it sends a Green Signal until it receives another Green Signal, when it resets automatically and begins counting again.
buildingDefs.name: LogicCounter

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Critters and Eggs in the Room is greater than the selected threshold.

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICCRITTERCOUNTSENSOR">Critter Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Detecting critter populations can help adjust their automated feeding and care regimens.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the number of eggs and critters in a room.
buildingDefs.name: LogicCritterCountSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICDISEASESENSOR">Germ Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Detecting germ populations can help block off or clean up dangerous areas.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on quantity of surrounding Germs.
buildingDefs.name: LogicDiseaseSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal while a Duplicant is in the sensor's tile range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICDUPLICANTSENSOR">Duplicant Motion Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Motion sensors save power by only enabling buildings when Duplicants are nearby.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on whether a Duplicant is in the sensor's range.
buildingDefs.name: LogicDuplicantSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the selected Gas is detected

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICELEMENTSENSORGAS">Gas Element Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: These sensors can detect the presence of a specific gas and alter systems accordingly.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected on this sensor's tile. Sends a Red Signal when the selected Gas is not present.
buildingDefs.name: LogicElementSensorGas

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the selected Liquid is detected

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICELEMENTSENSORLIQUID">Liquid Element Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: These sensors can detect the presence of a specific liquid and alter systems accordingly.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected on this sensor's tile. Sends a Red Signal when the selected Liquid is not present.
buildingDefs.name: LogicElementSensorLiquid

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATEAND">AND Gate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: This gate outputs a Green Signal when both its inputs are receiving Green Signals at the same time.
buildingDefs.Effect: Outputs a Green Signal when both Input A AND Input B are receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal when even one Input is receiving Red.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateAND

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATEOR">OR Gate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: This gate outputs a Green Signal if receiving one or more Green Signals.
buildingDefs.Effect: Outputs a Green Signal if at least one of Input A OR Input B is receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal when neither Input A or Input B are receiving Green.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateOR

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATEXOR">XOR Gate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: This gate outputs a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving a Green Signal.
buildingDefs.Effect: Outputs a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal if both or neither Inputs are receiving a Green Signal.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateXOR

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATENOT">NOT Gate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: This gate reverses automation signals, turning a Green Signal into a Red Signal and vice versa.
buildingDefs.Effect: Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Red Signal. Outputs a Red Signal when its Input is receiving a Green Signal.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateNOT

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATEBUFFER">BUFFER Gate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: This gate continues outputting a Green Signal for a short time after the gate stops receiving a Green Signal.
buildingDefs.Effect: Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Green Signal. Continues sending a Green Signal for an amount of buffer time after the Input receives a Red Signal.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateBUFFER

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATEFILTER">FILTER Gate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: This gate only lets a Green Signal through if its Input has received a Green Signal that lasted longer than the selected filter time.
buildingDefs.Effect: Only lets a Green Signal through if the Input has received a Green Signal for longer than the selected filter time. Will continue outputting a Red Signal if the Green Signal did not last long enough.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateFILTER

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATEMULTIPLEXER">Signal Selector</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Signal Selectors can be used to select which automation signal is relevant to pass through to a given circuit
buildingDefs.Effect: Select which one of four Input signals should be sent out the Output, using Control Inputs. Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Input is selected.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateMultiplexer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICGATEDEMULTIPLEXER">Signal Distributor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Signal Distributors can be used to choose which circuit should receive a given automation signal.
buildingDefs.Effect: Route a single Input signal out one of four possible Outputs, based on the selection made by the Control Inputs. Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Output is selected.
buildingDefs.name: LogicGateDemultiplexer

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if detected Radbolts are within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICHEPSENSOR">Radbolt Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radbolt sensors can send a signal when a Radbolt passes over them.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Radbolts detected enters the chosen range.
buildingDefs.name: LogicHEPSensor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICHAMMER">Hammer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The hammer makes neat sounds when it strikes buildings.
buildingDefs.Effect: In its default orientation, the hammer strikes the building to the left when it receives a Green Signal. Each building has a unique sound when struck by the hammer. The hammer does no damage when it strikes.
buildingDefs.name: LogicHammer

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Receiving: Green Signal

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICINTERASTEROIDRECEIVER">Automation Receiver</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Receives automation signals from space.
buildingDefs.Effect: Receives a Green Signal or a Red Signal from an Automation Broadcaster over vast distances in space. Both the Automation Receiver and the Automation Broadcaster must be exposed to space to function.
buildingDefs.name: LogicInterasteroidReceiver

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICINTERASTEROIDSENDER">Automation Broadcaster</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Sends automation signals into space.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal to an Automation Receiver over vast distances in space. Both the Automation Broadcaster and the Automation Receiver must be exposed to space to function.
buildingDefs.name: LogicInterasteroidSender

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if ambient Brightness is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICLIGHTSENSOR">Light Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Light sensors can tell surface bunker doors above solar panels to open or close based on solar light levels.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Brightness enters the chosen range.
buildingDefs.name: LogicLightSensor

LogicInputPorts.activeDescription: Green Signal: Set the internal Memory to Green
Green Signal: Reset the internal Memory to Red
