LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Outputs a Green Signal if the internal Memory is set to Green
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Outputs a Red Signal if the internal Memory is set to Red

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICMEMORY">Memory Toggle</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A Memory stores a Green Signal received in the Set Port (S) until the Reset Port (R) receives a Green Signal.
buildingDefs.Effect: Contains an internal Memory, and will output whatever signal is stored in that Memory. Signals sent to the Inputs only affect the Memory, and do not pass through to the Output. Sending a Green Signal to the Set Port (S) will set the memory to Green. Sending a Green Signal to the Reset Port (R) will reset the memory back to Red.
buildingDefs.name: LogicMemory

LogicInputPorts.inactiveDescription: Red Signal: Prevent Power from flowing through connected circuits

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICPOWERRELAY">Power Shutoff</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Automated systems save power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.
buildingDefs.name: LogicPowerRelay

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if Gas pressure is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICPRESSURESENSORGAS">Atmo Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Atmo sensors can be used to prevent excess oxygen production and overpressurization.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Gas pressure enters the chosen range.
buildingDefs.name: LogicPressureSensorGas

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if Liquid pressure is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICPRESSURESENSORLIQUID">Hydro Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A hydro sensor can tell a pump to refill its basin as soon as it contains too little liquid.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Liquid pressure enters the chosen range. Must be submerged in Liquid.
buildingDefs.name: LogicPressureSensorLiquid

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if ambient Radiation is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICRADIATIONSENSOR">Radiation Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radiation sensors can disable buildings when they detect dangerous levels of radiation.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Radiation enters the chosen range.
buildingDefs.name: LogicRadiationSensor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICRIBBONBRIDGE">Automation Ribbon Bridge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Wire bridges allow multiple automation grids to exist in a small area without connecting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Runs one <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: LogicRibbonBridge

EffectDescription.tooltipText: Sending an <style="KKeyword">Automation Signal</style> with a higher <style="KKeyword">Bit Depth</style> than the connected <style="KKeyword">Logic Wire</style> can result in damage to the circuit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Logic ribbons use significantly less space to carry multiple automation signals.
buildingDefs.Effect:
A 4-Bit <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link> which can carry up to four automation signals.

Use a <link="LOGICRIBBONWRITER">Ribbon Writer</link> to output to multiple Bits, and a <link="LOGICRIBBONREADER">Ribbon Reader</link> to input from multiple Bits.
buildingDefs.name: LogicRibbon

LogicInputPorts.activeDescription: Green Signal: Reads a Green Signal from selected Bit
LogicInputPorts.inactiveDescription: Red Signal: Reads a Red Signal from selected Bit

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Green Signal: Sends a Green Signal to attached Automation Wire
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Red Signal: Sends a Red Signal to attached Automation Wire

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICRIBBONREADER">Ribbon Reader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Inputs the signal from a single Bit in an <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link> into an <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link>.
buildingDefs.Effect: Reads a Green Signal or a Red Signal from the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon onto an Automation Wire.
buildingDefs.name: LogicRibbonReader

LogicInputPorts.activeDescription: Green Signal: Receives Green Signal to be written to selected Bit
LogicInputPorts.inactiveDescription: Red Signal: Receives Red Signal to to be written selected Bit

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Green Signal: Writes a Green Signal to selected Bit of an Automation Ribbon
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Red Signal: Writes a Red Signal to selected Bit of an Automation Ribbon

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICRIBBONWRITER">Ribbon Writer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Translates the signal from an <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link> to a single Bit in an <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link>
buildingDefs.Effect: Writes a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon Automation Ribbon must be used as the output wire to avoid overloading.
buildingDefs.name: LogicRibbonWriter

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if toggled ON
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Sends a Red Signal if toggled OFF

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICSWITCH">Signal Switch</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Signal switches don't turn grids on and off like power switches, but add an extra signal.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal on an Automation grid.
buildingDefs.name: LogicSwitch

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if ambient Temperature is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICTEMPERATURESENSOR">Thermo Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Thermo sensors can disable buildings when they approach dangerous temperatures.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Temperature enters the chosen range.
buildingDefs.name: LogicTemperatureSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if current time is within the selected Green range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICTIMEOFDAYSENSOR">Cycle Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Cycle sensors ensure systems always turn on at the same time, day or night, every cycle.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sets an automatic Green Signal and Red Signal schedule within one day-night cycle.
buildingDefs.name: LogicTimeOfDaySensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal for the selected amount of Green time
LogicOutputPorts.inactiveDescription: Then, sends a Red Signal for the selected amount of Red time

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICTIMERSENSOR">Timer Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Timer sensors create automation schedules for very short or very long periods of time.
buildingDefs.Effect: Creates a timer to send Green Signals and Red Signals for specific amounts of time.
buildingDefs.name: LogicTimerSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if current Wattage is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICWATTAGESENSOR">Wattage Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Wattage sensors can send a signal when a building has switched on or off.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Wattage consumed enters the chosen range.
buildingDefs.name: LogicWattageSensor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICWIREBRIDGE">Automation Wire Bridge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Wire bridges allow multiple automation grids to exist in a small area without connecting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Runs one <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: LogicWireBridge

EffectDescription.tooltipText: Sending an <style="KKeyword">Automation Signal</style> with a higher <style="KKeyword">Bit Depth</style> than the connected <style="KKeyword">Logic Wire</style> can result in damage to the circuit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Automation wire is used to connect building ports to automation gates.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Connects buildings to <link="LOGIC">Sensors</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: LogicWire

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STORYTRAITLONELYMINION">Gravitas Shipping Container</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Its occupant has been alone for so long, he's forgotten what friendship feels like.
buildingDefs.Effect:
A large transport unit from the facility's sub-sub-basement.

It has been modified into a crude yet functional temporary shelter.
buildingDefs.name: LonelyMinionHouse

buildingDefs.Name: Mailbox
buildingDefs.Desc: There's nothing quite like receiving homemade gifts in the mail.
buildingDefs.Effect: Displays a single edible object.
buildingDefs.name: LonelyMailBox

buildingDefs.Name: <link="LUXURYBED">Comfy Bed</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants prefer comfy beds to cots and wake up more rested after sleeping in them.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides a sleeping area for one Duplicant and restores additional stamina.

Duplicants will automatically sleep in their assigned beds at night.
buildingDefs.name: LuxuryBed

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MACHINESHOP">Mechanics Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants will only improve the efficiency of buildings in the same room as this station.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows the assigned <link="MACHINETECHNICIAN">Engineer</link> to improve building production efficiency.

This building is a necessary component of the Machine Shop room.
buildingDefs.name: MachineShop

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MANUALGENERATOR">Manual Generator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Watching Duplicants run on it is adorable... the electrical power is just an added bonus.
buildingDefs.Effect: Converts manual labor into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.
buildingDefs.name: ManualGenerator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MANUALHIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Manual Radbolt Generator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Refines radioactive ores to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of your choosing.
buildingDefs.name: ManualHighEnergyParticleSpawner

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MANUALPRESSUREDOOR">Manual Airlock</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Airlocks can quarter off dangerous areas and prevent gases from seeping into the colony.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Wild <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> cannot pass through doors.
buildingDefs.name: ManualPressureDoor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MARBLESCULPTURE">Marble Block</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: MarbleSculpture

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MASSAGETABLE">Massage Table</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Massage tables quickly reduce extreme stress, at the cost of power production.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Rapidly reduces <link="STRESS">Stress</link> for the Duplicant user.

Duplicants will automatically seek a massage table when <link="STRESS">Stress</link> exceeds breaktime range.
buildingDefs.name: MassageTable

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MASSIVEHEATSINK">Anti Entropy Thermo-Nullifier</link>
buildingDefs.Effect:
A self-sustaining machine powered by what appears to be refined <link="UNOBTANIUM">Neutronium</link>.

Absorbs and neutralizes <link="HEAT">Heat</link> energy when provided with piped <link="HYDROGEN">Hydrogen Gas</link>.
buildingDefs.name: MassiveHeatSink

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MECHANICALSURFBOARD">Mechanical Surfboard</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Mechanical waves make for radical relaxation time.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Some <link="WATER">Water</link> gets splashed on the floor during use.
buildingDefs.name: MechanicalSurfboard

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MEDICALCOT">Triage Cot</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants use triage cots to recover from physical injuries and receive aid from peers.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Accelerates <link="HEALTH">Health</link> restoration and the healing of physical injuries.

Revives incapacitated Duplicants.
buildingDefs.name: MedicalCot

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MEGABRAINTANK">Somnium Synthesizer</link>
buildingDefs.Effect:
An organic multi-cortex repository and processing system fuelled by <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Analyzes <link="DREAMJOURNAL">Dream Journals</link> produced by Duplicants wearing <link="SLEEPCLINICPAJAMAS">Pajamas</link>.

Provides a sustainable boost to Duplicant skills and abilities throughout the colony.
buildingDefs.name: MegaBrainTank

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MESHTILE">Mesh Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Mesh tile can be used to make Duplicant pathways in areas where liquid flows.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Does not obstruct <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> or <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow.
buildingDefs.name: MeshTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="METALREFINERY">Metal Refinery</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Refined metals are necessary to build advanced electronics and technologies.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metals</link> from raw <link="RAWMETAL">Metal Ore</link>.

Significantly <link="HEAT">Heats</link> and outputs the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> piped into it.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: MetalRefinery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="METALSCULPTURE">Metal Block</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: MetalSculpture

buildingDefs.Name: <link="METALTILE">Metal Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Heat travels much more quickly through metal tile than other types of flooring.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.
buildingDefs.name: MetalTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="METHANEGENERATOR">Natural Gas Generator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Natural gas generators leak polluted water and are best built above a waste reservoir.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts <link="METHANE">Natural Gas</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> and <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.
buildingDefs.name: MethaneGenerator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MICROBEMUSHER">Microbe Musher</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Musher recipes will keep Duplicants fed, but may impact health and morale over time.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces low quality <link="FOOD">Food</link> using common ingredients.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: MicrobeMusher

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MILKFATSEPARATOR">Brackwax Gleaner</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants can slather up with brackwax to increase their travel speed in transit tubes.
buildingDefs.Effect: Refines <link="MILK">Brackene</link> into <link="BRINE">Brine</link> and <link="MILKFAT">Brackwax</link>, and emits <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link>.
buildingDefs.name: MilkFatSeparator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MILKFEEDER">Critter Fountain</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It's easier to tolerate overcrowding when you're all hopped up on brackene.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Dispenses <link="MILK">Brackene</link> to a wide variety of <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Accessing the fountain significantly improves <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>' moods.
buildingDefs.name: MilkFeeder

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MILKPRESS">Plant Pulverizer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: For Duplicants who are too squeamish to milk critters.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Crushes organic materials to extract liquids such as <link="MILK">Brackene</link> or <link="PHYTOOIL">Phyto Oil</link>.

<link="MILK">Brackene</link> can be used to refill the <link="MILKFEEDER">Critter Fountain</link>.
buildingDefs.name: MilkPress

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MILKINGSTATION">Milking Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The harvested liquid is basically the equivalent of soda for critters.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants with the <link="RANCHING2">Critter Ranching II</link> skill to milk <link="MOO">Gassy Moos</link> for <link="MILK">Brackene</link>.

<link="MILK">Brackene</link> can be used to refill the <link="MILKFEEDER">Critter Fountain</link>.
buildingDefs.name: MilkingStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MINERALDEOXIDIZER">Oxygen Diffuser</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Oxygen diffusers are inefficient, but output enough oxygen to keep a colony breathing.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts large amounts of <link="ALGAE">Algae</link> into <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.
buildingDefs.name: MineralDeoxidizer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MISSILELAUNCHER">Meteor Blaster</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Some meteors drop harvestable resources when they're blown to smithereens.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Fires explosive projectiles at incoming space objects to defend the colony from impact-related damage.

Projectiles must be crafted at a <link="MISSILEFABRICATOR">Blastshot Maker</link>.

Range: 16 tiles horizontally, 32 tiles vertically.
buildingDefs.name: MissileLauncher

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MISSILEFABRICATOR">Blastshot Maker</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Blastshot shells are an effective defense against incoming meteor showers.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces <link="MISSILELAUNCHER">Blastshot</link> from <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metals</link> combined with <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: MissileFabricator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MISSIONCONTROLCLUSTER">Mission Control Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Like a backseat driver who actually does know better.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides guidance data to rocket pilots within range, to improve rocket speed.

Must be operated by a Duplicant with the <link="ASTRONOMY">Astronomy</link> skill.

Requires a clear line of sight to space in order to function.
buildingDefs.name: MissionControlCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTBRIDGE">Rocket Port Extension</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Allows rocket platforms to be built farther apart.
buildingDefs.Effect: Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or any <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.
buildingDefs.name: ModularLaunchpadPortBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTGAS">Gas Rocket Port Loader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Loads <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or another <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.

Uses the gas filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.
buildingDefs.name: ModularLaunchpadPortGas

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTGASUNLOADER">Gas Rocket Port Unloader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Unloads <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or another <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.

Uses the gas filters set on this unloader.
buildingDefs.name: ModularLaunchpadPortGasUnloader

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTLIQUID">Liquid Rocket Port Loader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Loads <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or another <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.

Uses the liquid filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.
buildingDefs.name: ModularLaunchpadPortLiquid

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTLIQUIDUNLOADER">Liquid Rocket Port Unloader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Unloads <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or another <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.

Uses the liquid filters set on this unloader.
buildingDefs.name: ModularLaunchpadPortLiquidUnloader

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Solid Rocket Port Loader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Loads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solids</link> to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or another <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.

Uses the solid material filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.
buildingDefs.name: ModularLaunchpadPortSolid

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLIDUNLOADER">Solid Rocket Port Unloader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Unloads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solids</link> from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or another <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.

Uses the solid material filters set on this unloader.
buildingDefs.name: ModularLaunchpadPortSolidUnloader

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MONUMENTBOTTOM">Monument Base</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The base of a monument must be constructed first.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Builds the bottom section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.
buildingDefs.name: MonumentBottom

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MONUMENTMIDDLE">Monument Midsection</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Customized sections of a Great Monument can be mixed and matched.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Builds the middle section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.
buildingDefs.name: MonumentMiddle

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MONUMENTTOP">Monument Top</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Building a Great Monument will declare to the universe that this hunk of rock is your own.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Builds the top section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.
buildingDefs.name: MonumentTop

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STORYTRAITMORBROVER">Biobot Builder</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Allows a skilled Duplicant to manufacture a steady supply of icky yet effective bots.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses <link="ZOMBIESPORES">Zombie Spores</link> and <link="STEEL">Steel</link> to craft biofueled machines that can be sent into hostile environments.

Defunct <link="STORYTRAITMORBROVER">Biobots</link> drop harvestable <link="STEEL">Steel</link>.
buildingDefs.name: MorbRoverMaker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MOUDLINGTILE">Trimming Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Trimming is used as purely decorative lining for walls and structures.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: MouldingTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="MULTIMINIONDININGTABLE">Communal Table</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Given the option, Duplicants prefer to dine with friends.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Gives three Duplicants a place to eat.

Sharing a meal with one or more companions provides a <link="MORALE">Morale</link> boost.
buildingDefs.name: MultiMinionDiningTable

buildingDefs.Name: <link="NOSECONEBASIC">Basic Nosecone</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Every rocket requires a nosecone to fly.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Protects a rocket during takeoff and entry, enabling space travel.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and built at the top of a rocket.
buildingDefs.name: NoseconeBasic

buildingDefs.Name: <link="NOSECONEHARVEST">Drillcone</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Collecting the drilled-out resources requires a storage module.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Enables a rocket to drill into interstellar debris to free up <link="ELEMENTSGAS">gas</link>, <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">liquid</link> and <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">solid</link> resources in space.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Must be built at the top of a rocket with <link="ELEMENTSGAS">gas</link>, <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">liquid</link> or <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">solid</link> Cargo Module attached to store the appropriate resources.
buildingDefs.name: NoseconeHarvest

buildingDefs.Name: <link="NUCLEARREACTOR">Research Reactor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Radbolt generators and reflectors make radiation usable by other buildings.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses <link="ENRICHEDURANIUM">Enriched Uranium</link> to produce <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> for Radbolt production.

Generates a massive amount of <link="HEAT">Heat</link>. Overheating will result in an explosive meltdown.
buildingDefs.name: NuclearReactor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

buildingDefs.Name: <link="NUCLEARRESEARCHCENTER">Materials Study Terminal</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Comes with a few ions thrown in, free of charge.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Conducts <link="RESEARCHDLC1">Materials Science Research</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Radbolts.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="ATOMICRESEARCH">Applied Sciences Research</link> skill.
buildingDefs.name: NuclearResearchCenter

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OBJECTDISPENSER">Automatic Dispenser</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Automatic dispensers will store and drop resources in small quantities.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores any Solid Materials delivered to it by Duplicants. Dumps stored materials back into the world when it receives a Green Signal.
buildingDefs.name: ObjectDispenser

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OILREFINERY">Oil Refinery</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Petroleum can only be produced from the refinement of crude oil.
buildingDefs.Effect: Converts <link="CRUDEOIL">Crude Oil</link> into <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link> and <link="METHANE">Natural Gas</link>.
buildingDefs.name: OilRefinery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OILWELLCAP">Oil Well</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Water pumped into an oil reservoir cannot be recovered.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Extracts <link="CRUDEOIL">Crude Oil</link> using clean <link="WATER">Water</link>.

Must be built atop an <link="OILWELL">Oil Reservoir</link>.
buildingDefs.name: OilWellCap

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ORBITALCARGOMODULE">Orbital Cargo Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It's a generally good idea to pack some supplies when exploring unknown worlds.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Delivers cargo to the surface of Planetoids that do not yet have a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.
buildingDefs.name: OrbitalCargoModule

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ORBITALRESEARCHCENTER">Orbital Data Collection Lab</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Orbital Data Collection Labs record data while orbiting a Planetoid and write it to a <link="ORBITALRESEARCHDATABANK">Data Bank</link>.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Creates <link="ORBITALRESEARCHDATABANK">Data Banks</link> that can be consumed at a <link="DLC1COSMICRESEARCHCENTER">Virtual Planetarium</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link> and <link="POWER">Power</link>.
buildingDefs.name: OrbitalResearchCenter

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ORESCRUBBER">Ore Scrubber</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Scrubbers sanitize freshly mined materials before they're brought into the colony.
buildingDefs.Effect: Kills a significant amount of <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> present on <link="RAWMINERAL">Raw Ore</link>.
buildingDefs.name: OreScrubber

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OUTHOUSE">Outhouse</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The colony that eats together, excretes together.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves.

Requires no <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Piping</link>.

Must be periodically emptied of <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Outhouse

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OXIDIZERTANKCLUSTER">Large Solid Oxidizer Tank</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Solid oxidizers allows rocket fuel to be efficiently burned in the vacuum of space.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="OXYROCK">Oxylite</link> and other oxidizers for burning rocket fuels.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: OxidizerTankCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OXIDIZERTANKLIQUIDCLUSTER">Liquid Oxidizer Tank</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Liquid oxygen improves the thrust-to-mass ratio of rocket fuels.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="LIQUIDOXYGEN">Liquid Oxygen</link> for burning rocket fuels. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: OxidizerTankLiquidCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OXYGENMASKLOCKER">Oxygen Mask Dock</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: An oxygen mask dock will store and refill masks while they're not in use.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="OXYGENMASK">Oxygen Masks</link> and refuels them with <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Build next to an <link="OXYGENMASKMARKER">Oxygen Mask Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants put on masks when passing by.
buildingDefs.name: OxygenMaskLocker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OXYGENMASKMARKER">Oxygen Mask Checkpoint</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must put on or take off an <link="OXYGENMASK">Oxygen Mask</link>.

Must be built next to an <link="OXYGENMASKLOCKER">Oxygen Mask Dock</link>.

Can be rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: OxygenMaskMarker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OXYGENMASKSTATION">Oxygen Mask Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants can't pass by a station if it lacks enough oxygen to fill a mask.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses designated <link="METAL">Metal Ores</link> from filter settings to create <link="OXYGENMASK">Oxygen Masks</link>.

Automatically draws in ambient <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> to fill masks.

Marks a threshold where Duplicants must put on or take off a mask.

Can be rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: OxygenMaskStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="OXYLITEREFINERY">Oxylite Refinery</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Oxylite is a solid and easily transportable source of consumable oxygen.
buildingDefs.Effect: Synthesizes <link="OXYROCK">Oxylite</link> using <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and a small amount of <link="GOLD">Gold</link>.
buildingDefs.name: OxyliteRefinery

buildingDefs.Name: Security Door
buildingDefs.Effect: A strong door with a sophisticated genetic lock.
buildingDefs.name: POIBunkerExteriorDoor

buildingDefs.Name: Showroom Doors
buildingDefs.Effect: Large double doors identical to those you might find at the main entrance to a large facility.
buildingDefs.name: POIDlc2ShowroomDoor

buildingDefs.Name: Security Door
buildingDefs.Effect: A strong door with a sophisticated genetic lock.
buildingDefs.name: POIDoorInternal

buildingDefs.Name: Lobby Doors
buildingDefs.Effect: Large double doors that were once the main entrance to a large facility.
buildingDefs.name: POIFacilityDoor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PARKSIGN">Park Sign</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Passing through parks will increase Duplicant Morale.
buildingDefs.Effect: Classifies an area as a Park or Nature Reserve.
buildingDefs.name: ParkSign

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PETROLEUMGENERATOR">Petroleum Generator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Petroleum generators have a high energy output but produce a great deal of waste.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link>, <link="ETHANOL">Ethanol</link> or <link="REFINEDLIPID">Biodiesel</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> and <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.
buildingDefs.name: PetroleumGenerator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PHONOBOX">Jukebot</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Dancing helps Duplicants get their innermost feelings out.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Plays music for Duplicants to dance to on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Phonobox

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PIONEERMODULE">Trailblazer Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: That's one small step for Dupekind.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Enables travel to Planetoids that do not yet have a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

Can hold one Duplicant traveller.

Deployment is available while in a Starmap hex adjacent to a Planetoid. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.
buildingDefs.name: PioneerModule

LogicInputPorts.activeDescription: Green Signal: Display the configured Green Signal pixels
LogicInputPorts.inactiveDescription: Red Signal: Display the configured Red Signal pixels

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PIXELPACK">Pixel Pack</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Four pixels which can be individually designated different colors.
buildingDefs.Effect: Pixels can be designated a color when it receives a Green Signal and a different color when it receives a Red Signal. Input from an Automation Wire controls the whole strip. Input from an Automation Ribbon can control individual pixels on the strip.
buildingDefs.name: PixelPack

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PLANTERBOX">Planter Box</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Domestically grown seeds mature more quickly than wild plants.
buildingDefs.Effect: Grows one <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.
buildingDefs.name: PlanterBox

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PLASTICTILE">Plastic Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Plastic tile is mildly antiseptic and can help limit the spread of germs in a colony.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.
buildingDefs.name: PlasticTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="POLYMERIZER">Polymer Press</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Plastic can be used to craft unique buildings and goods.
buildingDefs.Effect: Converts <link="PLASTIFIABLELIQUID">Plastic Monomers</link> into raw <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Polymerizer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="POWERCONTROLSTATION">Power Control Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Only one Duplicant may be assigned to a station at a time.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces <link="POWERSTATIONTOOLS">Microchip</link> to increase the <link="POWER">Power</link> output of generators.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="TECHNICALS2">Tune Up</link> trait.
buildingDefs.name: PowerControlStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="POWERTRANSFORMER">Large Power Transformer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It's a power transformer, but larger.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Limits <link="POWER">Power</link> flowing through the Transformer to 4 kW.

Connect <link="BATTERY">Batteries</link> on the large side to act as a valve and prevent <link="WIRE">Wires</link> from drawing more than 4 kW.

Can be rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: PowerTransformer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="POWERTRANSFORMERSMALL">Power Transformer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Limiting the power drawn by wires prevents them from incurring overload damage.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Limits <link="POWER">Power</link> flowing through the Transformer to 1000 W.

Connect <link="BATTERY">Batteries</link> on the large side to act as a valve and prevent <link="WIRE">Wires</link> from drawing more than 1000 W.

Can be rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: PowerTransformerSmall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PRESSUREDOOR">Mechanized Airlock</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Mechanized airlocks open and close more quickly than other types of door.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Functions as a <link="MANUALPRESSUREDOOR">Manual Airlock</link> when no <link="POWER">Power</link> is available.

Wild <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> cannot pass through doors.
buildingDefs.name: PressureDoor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PRESSURESWITCHGAS">Atmo Switch</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: An atmo switch shuts off power when the air pressure surrounding it surpasses the set threshold.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Automatically turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off using ambient <link="PRESSURE">Gas Pressure</link> .

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.
buildingDefs.name: PressureSwitchGas

buildingDefs.Name: <link="PRESSURESWITCHLIQUID">Hydro Switch</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A hydro switch shuts off power when the liquid pressure surrounding it surpasses the set threshold.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Automatically turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off using ambient <link="PRESSURE">Liquid Pressure</link>.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.
buildingDefs.name: PressureSwitchLiquid

buildingDefs.Name: Lab Wall
buildingDefs.Effect: A regular wall that once existed in a working lab.
buildingDefs.name: PropGravitasLabWall

buildingDefs.Name: Lab Window
buildingDefs.Effect: A lab window. Formerly a portal to the outside world.
buildingDefs.name: PropGravitasLabWindow

buildingDefs.Name: Lab Window
buildingDefs.Effect:
A lab window.

Someone once stared out of this, contemplating the results of an experiment.
buildingDefs.name: PropGravitasLabWindowHorizontal

buildingDefs.Name: Wall
buildingDefs.Effect: The wall of a once-great scientific facility.
buildingDefs.name: PropGravitasWall

buildingDefs.Name: Wall
buildingDefs.Effect: The wall of an ambitious research and development department.
buildingDefs.name: PropGravitasWallPurple

buildingDefs.Name: Wall
buildingDefs.Effect: The wall of an ambitious research and development department.
buildingDefs.name: PropGravitasWallPurpleWhiteDiagonal

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RADIATIONLIGHT">Radiation Lamp</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants can become sick if exposed to radiation without protection.
buildingDefs.Effect: Emits <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> when <link="POWER">Powered</link> that can be collected by a <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generator</link>.
buildingDefs.name: RadiationLight

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RAILGUN">Interplanetary Launcher</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It's tempting to climb inside but trust me... don't.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Launches <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> between Planetoids.

Payloads can contain <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, or <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> materials.

Cannot transport Duplicants.
buildingDefs.name: RailGun

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RAILGUNPAYLOADOPENER">Payload Opener</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Payload openers can be hooked up to conveyors, plumbing and ventilation for improved sorting.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Unpacks <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> delivered by Duplicants.

Automatically separates <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> materials and distributes them to the appropriate systems.
buildingDefs.name: RailGunPayloadOpener

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RANCHSTATION">Grooming Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A groomed critter is a happy, healthy, productive critter.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows the assigned <link="RANCHER">Rancher</link> to care for <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching</link> skill.
buildingDefs.name: RanchStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RATIONBOX">Ration Box</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Ration boxes keep food safe from hungry critters, but don't slow food spoilage.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores a small amount of <link="FOOD">Food</link>.

Food must be delivered to boxes by Duplicants.
buildingDefs.name: RationBox

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when full

buildingDefs.Name: <link="REFRIGERATOR">Refrigerator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Food spoilage can be slowed by ambient conditions as well as by refrigerators.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores <link="FOOD">Food</link> at an ideal <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> to prevent spoilage.
buildingDefs.name: Refrigerator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RESEARCHCENTER">Research Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Research stations are necessary for unlocking all research tiers.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Conducts <link="RESEARCH">Novice Research</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes <link="DIRT">Dirt</link>.
buildingDefs.name: ResearchCenter

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RESEARCHMODULE">Research Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Unlocks the possibility of Gathering Databanks floating in space
buildingDefs.Effect: The Research module allows the rocket to gather Data banks that happen to be on the same hex cell than the rocket when it travels through the galaxy
buildingDefs.name: ResearchClusterModule

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RESETSKILLSSTATION">Skill Scrubber</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Erase skills from a Duplicant's mind, returning them to their default abilities.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Refunds a Duplicant's Skill Points for reassignment.

Duplicants will lose all assigned skills in the process.
buildingDefs.name: ResetSkillsStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKCRUSHER">Rock Crusher</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rock Crushers loosen nuggets from raw ore and can process many different resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Inefficiently produces refined materials from raw resources.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: RockCrusher

LogicInputPorts.activeDescription: Green Signal: Restrict access to interior buildings
LogicInputPorts.inactiveDescription: Red Signal: Unrestrict access to interior buildings

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETCONTROLSTATION">Rocket Control Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Someone needs to be around to jiggle the controls when the screensaver comes on.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to use pilot-operated rockets and control access to interior buildings.

Assigned Duplicants must have the <link="ROCKETPILOTING1">Rocket Piloting</link> skill.
buildingDefs.name: RocketControlStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETENVELOPEWINDOWTILE">Rocket Window</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: I can see my asteroid from here!
buildingDefs.Effect: The window of a rocket.
buildingDefs.name: RocketEnvelopeWindowTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORGASINPUT">Gas Intake Fitting</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It's basically central-vac.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> to be pumped into rocket storage via <link="GASCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Sends gas to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorGasInput

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORGASINPUTPORT">Gas Spacefarer Input Port</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A direct attachment leading to the output port on the exterior of the rocket.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows a direct conduit connection out of the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of the rocket.
Can be used to vent <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gasses</link> to space during flight.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorGasInputPort

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORGASOUTPUT">Gas Output Fitting</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Refreshing breezes, on-demand.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> to be drawn from rocket storage via <link="GASCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Draws gas from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorGasOutput

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORGASOUTPUTPORT">Gas Spacefarer Output Port</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A direct attachment to the input port on the exterior of a rocket.
buildingDefs.Effect: Allows a direct conduit connection into the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of a rocket.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorGasOutputPort

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORLIQUIDINPUT">Liquid Intake Fitting</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Begone, foul waters!
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> to be pumped into rocket storage via <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Sends liquid to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorLiquidInput

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORLIQUIDINPUTPORT">Liquid Spacefarer Input Port</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A direct attachment to the output port on the exterior of a rocket.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows a direct conduit connection out of the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of a rocket.
Can be used to vent <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> to space during flight.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorLiquidInputPort

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORLIQUIDOUTPUT">Liquid Output Fitting</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Now if only we had some water balloons...
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> to be drawn from rocket storage via <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Draws liquid from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorLiquidOutput

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORLIQUIDOUTPUTPORT">Liquid Spacefarer Output Port</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A direct attachment to the input port on the exterior of a rocket.
buildingDefs.Effect: Allows a direct conduit connection into the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of a rocket.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorLiquidOutputPort

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORPOWERPLUG">Power Outlet Fitting</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Outlets conveniently power buildings inside a cockpit using their rocket's power stores.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides <link="POWER">Power</link> to connected buildings.

Pulls power from <link="BATTERYMODULE">Battery Modules</link> and Rocket Engines.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorPowerPlug

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORSOLIDINPUT">Conveyor Receptacle Fitting</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Why organize your shelves when you can just shove everything in here?
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> to be moved into rocket storage via <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rails</link>.

Sends solid material to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorSolidInput

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETINTERIORSOLIDOUTPUT">Conveyor Loader Fitting</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: For accessing your stored luggage mid-flight.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> to be moved out of rocket storage via <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rails</link>.

Draws solid material from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.
buildingDefs.name: RocketInteriorSolidOutput

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROCKETENVELOPETILE">Rocket Wall</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Keeps the space out.
buildingDefs.Effect: The walls of a rocket.
buildingDefs.name: RocketWallTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="ROLESTATION">Skills Board</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A skills board can teach special skills to Duplicants they can't learn on their own.
buildingDefs.Effect: Allows Duplicants to spend Skill Points to learn new <link="JOBS">Skills</link>.
buildingDefs.name: RoleStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="RUSTDEOXIDIZER">Rust Deoxidizer</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rust and salt goes in, oxygen comes out.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts <link="RUST">Rust</link> into <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and <link="CHLORINE">Chlorine Gas</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.
buildingDefs.name: RustDeoxidizer

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SAUNA">Sauna</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A steamy sauna soothes away all the aches and pains.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Uses <link="STEAM">Steam</link> to create a relaxing atmosphere.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link> and provides a lingering sense of warmth.
buildingDefs.name: Sauna

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SCANNERMODULE">Cartographic Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Allows Duplicants to boldly go where other Duplicants haven't been yet.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Automatically analyzes adjacent space while on a voyage. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: ScannerModule

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SCOUTMODULE">Rover's Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rover can conduct explorations of planetoids that don't have rocket platforms built.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Deploys one <link="SCOUT">Rover Bot</link> for remote Planetoid exploration.

Deployment is available while in a Starmap hex adjacent to a Planetoid. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: ScoutModule

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SCULPTURE">Large Sculpting Block</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Moderately increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: Sculpture

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SHEARINGSTATION">Shearing Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Those critters aren't gonna shear themselves.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Shearing stations allow eligible <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> to be safely sheared for useful raw materials.

Visiting this building restores <link="CREATURES">Critters'</link> physical and emotional well-being.
buildingDefs.name: ShearingStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SHELF">Display Shelf</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It looks great even when it's empty.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Displays cherished items and increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be installed on a back wall.
buildingDefs.name: Shelf

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SHOWER">Shower</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Regularly showering will prevent Duplicants spreading germs to the things they touch.
buildingDefs.Effect: Improves Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link> and removes surface <link="DISEASE">Germs</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Shower

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SLUDGEPRESS">Sludge Press</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: What Duplicant doesn't love playing with mud?
buildingDefs.Effect:
Separates <link="MUD">Mud</link> and other sludges into their base elements.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: SludgePress

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SMALLOXIDIZERTANK">Small Solid Oxidizer Tank</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Solid oxidizers allows rocket fuel to be efficiently burned in the vacuum of space.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="FERTILIZER">Fertilizer</link> and <link="OXYROCK">Oxylite</link> for burning rocket fuels. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: SmallOxidizerTank

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SMALLSCULPTURE">Sculpting Block</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Minorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.
buildingDefs.name: SmallSculpture

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SODAFOUNTAIN">Soda Fountain</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Sparkling water puts a twinkle in a Duplicant's eye.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Creates soda from <link="WATER">Water</link> and <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link>.

Consuming soda water increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: SodaFountain

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLARPANEL">Solar Panel</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Solar panels convert high intensity sunlight into power and produce zero waste.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Must be exposed to space.
buildingDefs.name: SolarPanel

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLARPANELMODULE">Solar Panel Module</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Collect solar energy before takeoff and during flight.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Converts <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link> for use on rockets.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Must be exposed to space.
buildingDefs.name: SolarPanelModule

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CARGOBAYCLUSTER">Large Cargo Bay</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Holds more than a regular cargo bay.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to store most of the <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: CargoBayCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCARGOBAYSMALL">Cargo Bay</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants will fill cargo bays with any resources they find during space missions.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to store some of the <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: SolidCargoBaySmall

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCONDUITBRIDGE">Conveyor Bridge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Separating rail systems helps ensure materials go to the intended destinations.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Runs one <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: SolidConduitBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rails move materials where they'll be needed most, saving Duplicants the walk.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Transports <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> on a track between <link="SOLIDCONDUITINBOX">Conveyor Loader</link> and <link="SOLIDCONDUITOUTBOX">Conveyor Receptacle</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: SolidConduit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCONDUITINBOX">Conveyor Loader</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Material filters can be used to determine what resources are sent down the rail.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Loads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> onto <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> for transport.

Only loads the resources of your choosing.
buildingDefs.name: SolidConduitInbox

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCONDUITOUTBOX">Conveyor Receptacle</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: When materials reach the end of a rail they enter a receptacle to be used by Duplicants.
buildingDefs.Effect: Unloads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> from a <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> into storage.
buildingDefs.name: SolidConduitOutbox

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs on the object on the rail is within the selected range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCONDUITDISEASESENSOR">Conveyor Rail Germ Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the object on the rail.
buildingDefs.name: SolidConduitDiseaseSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the configured item is detected on the rail

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCONDUITELEMENTSENSOR">Conveyor Rail Element Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific item on a rail.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected item is detected on a rail.
buildingDefs.name: SolidConduitElementSensor

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if the contained item is within the selected Temperature range

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDCONDUITTEMPERATURESENSOR">Conveyor Rail Thermo Sensor</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their rail contents reach a certain temperature.
buildingDefs.Effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when rail contents enter the chosen Temperature range.
buildingDefs.name: SolidConduitTemperatureSensor

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDFILTER">Solid Filter</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: All solids are sent into the building's output conveyor, except the solid chosen for filtering.
buildingDefs.Effect: Separates one <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Material</link> from the conveyor, sending it into a dedicated <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link>.
buildingDefs.name: SolidFilter

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal if limit has been reached

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDLIMITVALVE">Conveyor Meter</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Conveyor Meters let an exact amount of materials pass through before shutting off.
buildingDefs.Effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn material transfer off when the specified amount has passed through it.
buildingDefs.name: SolidLimitValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDLOGICVALVE">Conveyor Shutoff</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Automated conveyors save power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
buildingDefs.Effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Material</link> transport on or off.
buildingDefs.name: SolidLogicValve

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDTRANSFERARM">Auto-Sweeper</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: An auto-sweeper's range can be viewed at any time by (ClickType/clicking) on the building.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Automates <link="CHORES">Sweeping</link> and <link="CHORES">Supplying</link> errands by sucking up all nearby <link="DECOR">Debris</link>.

Materials are automatically delivered to any <link="SOLIDCONDUITINBOX">Conveyor Loader</link>, <link="SOLIDCONDUITOUTBOX">Conveyor Receptacle</link>, storage, or buildings within range.
buildingDefs.name: SolidTransferArm

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SOLIDVENT">Conveyor Chute</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: When materials reach the end of a rail they are dropped back into the world.
buildingDefs.Effect: Unloads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> from a <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> onto the floor.
buildingDefs.name: SolidVent

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SPACEHEATER">Space Heater</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Space heaters are a welcome cure for cold, soggy feet.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Radiates a moderate amount of <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.

Requires <link="POWER">Power</link> in order to function.
buildingDefs.name: SpaceHeater

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SPECIALCARGOBAYCLUSTER">Critter Cargo Bay</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Critters do not require feeding during transit.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to transport <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> through space.

Specimens can be released into the colony upon the rocket's return.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.
buildingDefs.name: SpecialCargoBayCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SPICEGRINDER">Spice Grinder</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Crushed seeds and other edibles make excellent meal-enhancing additives.
buildingDefs.Effect: Produces ingredients that add benefits to <link="FOOD">foods</link> prepared at skilled cooking stations.
buildingDefs.name: SpiceGrinder

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STATERPILLAR">Plug Slug</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGENERATOR.DESC
buildingDefs.Effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGENERATOR.EFFECT
buildingDefs.name: StaterpillarGenerator

buildingDefs.Name: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGASCONNECTOR.NAME
buildingDefs.Desc: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGASCONNECTOR.DESC
buildingDefs.Effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGASCONNECTOR.EFFECT
buildingDefs.name: StaterpillarGasConnector

buildingDefs.Name: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARLIQUIDCONNECTOR.NAME
buildingDefs.Desc: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARLIQUIDCONNECTOR.DESC
buildingDefs.Effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARLIQUIDCONNECTOR.EFFECT
buildingDefs.name: StaterpillarLiquidConnector

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STEAMENGINECLUSTER">Steam Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Utilizes <link="STEAM">Steam</link> to propel rockets for space exploration.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: SteamEngineCluster

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STEAMTURBINE">[DEPRECATED] Steam Turbine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Useful for converting the geothermal energy of magma into usable power.
buildingDefs.Effect:
THIS BUILDING HAS BEEN DEPRECATED AND CANNOT BE BUILT.

Generates exceptional electrical <link="POWER">Power</link> using pressurized, <link="HEAT">Scalding</link> <link="STEAM">Steam</link>.

Outputs significantly cooler <link="STEAM">Steam</link> than it receives.

Air pressure beneath this building must be higher than pressure above for air to flow.
buildingDefs.name: SteamTurbine

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STEAMTURBINE2">Steam Turbine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Useful for converting the geothermal energy into usable power.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Draws in <link="STEAM">Steam</link> from the tiles directly below the machine's foundation and uses it to generate electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Outputs <link="WATER">Water</link>.
buildingDefs.name: SteamTurbine2

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STORAGELOCKER">Storage Bin</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Resources left on the floor become "debris" and lower decor when not put away.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores the <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> of your choosing.
buildingDefs.name: StorageLocker

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when full

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STORAGELOCKERSMART">Smart Storage Bin</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Smart storage bins can automate resource organization based on type and mass.
buildingDefs.Effect: Stores the Solid Materials of your choosing. Sends a Green Signal when bin is full.
buildingDefs.name: StorageLockerSmart

buildingDefs.Name: <link="STORAGETILE">Storage Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Storage tiles keep selected non-edible solids out of the way.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides built-in storage for small spaces.
buildingDefs.name: StorageTile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SUBLIMATIONSTATION">Sublimation Station</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Sublimation is the sublime process by which solids convert directly into gas.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Speeds up the conversion of <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link> into <link="CONTAMINATEDOXYGEN">Polluted Oxygen</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.
buildingDefs.name: SublimationStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SUGARENGINE">Sugar Engine</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Not the most stylish way to travel space, but certainly the tastiest.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Burns <link="SUCROSE">Sucrose</link> to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Sugar Engines have higher height restrictions than <link="CO2ENGINE">Carbon Dioxide Engines</link>, but move slower.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires a <link="OXIDIZERTANKCLUSTER">Large Solid Oxidizer Tank</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
buildingDefs.name: SugarEngine

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SUITFABRICATOR">Exosuit Forge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Exosuits can be filled with oxygen to allow Duplicants to safely enter hazardous areas.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Forges protective <link="EQUIPMENT">Exosuits</link> for Duplicants to wear.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: SuitFabricator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SUITLOCKER">Atmo Suit Dock</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: An atmo suit dock will empty atmo suits of waste, but only one suit can charge at a time.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Stores <link="ATMOSUIT">Atmo Suits</link> and refuels them with <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Empties suits of <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

Build next to an <link="SUITMARKER">Atmo Suit Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.
buildingDefs.name: SuitLocker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SUITMARKER">Atmo Suit Checkpoint</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of <link="ATMOSUIT">Atmo Suits</link>.

Must be built next to an <link="SUITLOCKER">Atmo Suit Dock</link>.

Can be rotated before construction.
buildingDefs.name: SuitMarker

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SUNLAMP">Sun Lamp</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: An artificial ray of sunshine.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Gives off <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link> level Lux.

Can be paired with <link="BEACHCHAIR">Beach Chairs</link>.
buildingDefs.name: SunLamp

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SUPERMATERIALREFINERY">Molecular Forge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Rare materials can be procured through rocket missions into space.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Processes <link="RAREMATERIALS">Rare Materials</link> into advanced industrial goods.

Rare materials can be retrieved from space missions.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
buildingDefs.name: SupermaterialRefinery

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SWEEPBOTSTATION">Sweepy's Dock</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The cute little face comes pre-installed.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Deploys an automated <link="SWEEPBOT">Sweepy Bot</link> to sweep up <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> debris and <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> spills.

Dock stores <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> and <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solids</link> gathered by the Sweepy.

Uses <link="POWER">Power</link> to recharge the Sweepy.

Duplicants will empty Dock storage into available storage bins.
buildingDefs.name: SweepBotStation

buildingDefs.Name: <link="SWITCH">Switch</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Switches can only affect buildings that come after them on a circuit.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.
buildingDefs.name: Switch

buildingDefs.Name: <link="TELEPHONE">Party Line Phone</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: You never know who you'll meet on the other line.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Can be used by one Duplicant to chat with themselves or with other Duplicants in different locations.

Chatting increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Telephone

buildingDefs.Name: Teleporter Pad
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants are just atoms as far as the pad's concerned.
buildingDefs.Effect: Instantly transports Duplicants and items to another portal with the same portal code.
buildingDefs.name: TeleportalPad

buildingDefs.Name: <link="TEMPERATURECONTROLLEDSWITCH">Thermo Switch</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Automated switches can be used to manage circuits in areas where Duplicants cannot enter.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Automatically turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off using ambient <link="HEAT">Temperature</link>.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.
buildingDefs.name: TemperatureControlledSwitch

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

buildingDefs.Name: Temporal Tear Opener
buildingDefs.Desc: Infinite possibilities, with a complimentary side of meteor showers.
buildingDefs.Effect: A powerful mechanism capable of tearing through the fabric of reality.
buildingDefs.name: TemporalTearOpener

buildingDefs.Name: <link="THERMALBLOCK">Tempshift Plate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The thermal properties of construction materials determine their heat retention.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Accelerates or buffers <link="HEAT">Heat</link> dispersal based on the construction material used.

Has a small area of effect.
buildingDefs.name: ThermalBlock

buildingDefs.Name: <link="TILE">Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Tile can be used to bridge gaps and get to unreachable areas.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases Duplicant runspeed.
buildingDefs.name: Tile

buildingDefs.Name: <link="TILEPOI">Tile</link>
buildingDefs.Effect: Used to build the walls and floor of rooms.
buildingDefs.name: TilePOI

buildingDefs.Name: <link="TRAVELTUBE">Transit Tube</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants will only exit a transit tube when a safe landing area is available beneath it.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Quickly transports Duplicants from a <link="TRAVELTUBEENTRANCE">Transit Tube Access</link> to the tube's end.

Only transports Duplicants.
buildingDefs.name: TravelTube

buildingDefs.Name: <link="TRAVELTUBEENTRANCE">Transit Tube Access</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants require access points to enter tubes, but not to exit them.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows Duplicants to enter the connected <link="TRAVELTUBE">Transit Tube</link> system.

Stops drawing <link="POWER">Power</link> once fully charged.
buildingDefs.name: TravelTubeEntrance

buildingDefs.Name: <link="TRAVELTUBEWALLBRIDGE">Transit Tube Crossing</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Tube crossings can run transit tubes through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="TRAVELTUBE">Transit Tubes</link> to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.
buildingDefs.name: TravelTubeWallBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="UNDERWATERCRITTERCONDO">Water Fort</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Even wild critters are happier after they've had a little R&R.
buildingDefs.Effect: A fancy respite area for adult <link="CRABSPECIES">Pokeshells</link> and <link="PACUSPECIES">Pacu</link>.
buildingDefs.name: UnderwaterCritterCondo

buildingDefs.Name: <link="URANIUMCENTRIFUGE">Uranium Centrifuge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Enriched uranium is a specialized substance that can be used to fuel powerful research reactors.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Extracts <link="ENRICHEDURANIUM">Enriched Uranium</link> from <link="URANIUMORE">Uranium Ore</link>.

Outputs <link="DEPLETEDURANIUM">Depleted Uranium</link> in molten form.
buildingDefs.name: UraniumCentrifuge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="VERTICALWINDTUNNEL">Vertical Wind Tunnel</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Duplicants love the feeling of high-powered wind through their hair.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Must be connected to a <link="POWER">Power Source</link>. To properly function, the area under this building must be left vacant.

Increases Duplicants <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: VerticalWindTunnel

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WALLTOILET">Wall Toilet</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Wall Toilets transmit fewer germs to Duplicants and require no emptying.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves. Empties directly on the other side of the wall.

Spreads very few <link="DISEASE">Germs</link>.
buildingDefs.name: WallToilet

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WARPCONDUITRECEIVER">Supply Teleporter Output</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The tubes at the back disappear into nowhere.
buildingDefs.Effect:
A machine capable of teleporting <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources to another asteroid.

It can be activated by a Duplicant with the <link="RESEARCHING2">Field Research</link> skill.

This is the receiving side.
buildingDefs.name: WarpConduitReceiver

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WARPCONDUITSENDER">Supply Teleporter Input</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: The tubes at the back disappear into nowhere.
buildingDefs.Effect:
A machine capable of teleporting <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources to another asteroid.

It can be activated by a Duplicant with the <link="RESEARCHING2">Field Research</link> skill.

This is the transmitting side.
buildingDefs.name: WarpConduitSender

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WASHBASIN">Wash Basin</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Germ spread can be reduced by building these where Duplicants often get dirty.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Removes some <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Wash Basins when passing by in the selected direction.
buildingDefs.name: WashBasin

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WASHSINK">Sink</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Sinks are plumbed and do not need to be manually emptied or refilled.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Removes <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Sinks when passing by in the selected direction.
buildingDefs.name: WashSink

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WATERCOOLER">Water Cooler</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Chatting with friends improves Duplicants' moods and reduces their stress.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Provides a gathering place for Duplicants during Downtime.

Improves Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.
buildingDefs.name: WaterCooler

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WATERPURIFIER">Water Sieve</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Sieves cannot kill germs and pass any they receive into their waste and water output.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Produces clean <link="WATER">Water</link> from <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link> using <link="SAND">Sand</link>.

Produces <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link>.
buildingDefs.name: WaterPurifier

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WIREBRIDGE">Wire Bridge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Splitting generators onto separate grids can prevent overloads and wasted electricity.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: WireBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WIREBRIDGEHIGHWATTAGE">Heavi-Watt Joint Plate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Joint plates can run Heavi-Watt wires through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Allows <link="HIGHWATTAGEWIRE">Heavi-Watt Wire</link> to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.
buildingDefs.name: WireBridgeHighWattage

EffectDescription.tooltipText: Drawing more than the maximum allowed <style="KKeyword">Watts</style> can result in damage to the circuit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WIRE">Wire</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Electrical wire is used to connect generators, batteries, and buildings.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Connects buildings to <link="POWER">Power</link> sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: Wire

EffectDescription.tooltipText: Drawing more than the maximum allowed <style="KKeyword">Watts</style> can result in damage to the circuit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="HIGHWATTAGEWIRE">Heavi-Watt Wire</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Higher wattage wire is used to avoid power overloads, particularly for strong generators.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than regular <link="WIRE">Wire</link> without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: HighWattageWire

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WIREREFINEDBRIDGE">Conductive Wire Bridge</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Splitting generators onto separate systems can prevent overloads and wasted electricity.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than a regular <link="WIREBRIDGE">Wire Bridge</link> without overloading.

Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: WireRefinedBridge

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WIREREFINEDBRIDGEHIGHWATTAGE">Heavi-Watt Conductive Joint Plate</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Joint plates can run Heavi-Watt wires through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than a regular <link="WIREBRIDGEHIGHWATTAGE">Heavi-Watt Joint Plate</link> without overloading.

Allows <link="HIGHWATTAGEWIRE">Heavi-Watt Wire</link> to be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: WireRefinedBridgeHighWattage

EffectDescription.tooltipText: Drawing more than the maximum allowed <style="KKeyword">Watts</style> can result in damage to the circuit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WIREREFINED">Conductive Wire</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: My Duplicants prefer the look of conductive wire to the regular raggedy stuff.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Connects buildings to <link="POWER">Power</link> sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: WireRefined

EffectDescription.tooltipText: Drawing more than the maximum allowed <style="KKeyword">Watts</style> can result in damage to the circuit

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WIREREFINEDHIGHWATTAGE">Heavi-Watt Conductive Wire</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Higher wattage wire is used to avoid power overloads, particularly for strong generators.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than regular <link="WIRE">Wire</link> without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.
buildingDefs.name: WireRefinedHighWattage

buildingDefs.Name: <link="WOODGASGENERATOR">Wood Burner</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Wood burners are small and easy to maintain, but produce a fair amount of heat.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Burns <link="WOOD">Wood</link> to produce electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> and <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.
buildingDefs.name: WoodGasGenerator

LogicOutputPorts.activeDescription: Sends a Green Signal when a critter has been trapped

buildingDefs.Name: <link="CREATUREAIRTRAP">Airborne Critter Trap</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: It needs to be armed prior to use.
buildingDefs.Effect:
Attracts and captures airborne <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Only Duplicants with the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching I</link> skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!
buildingDefs.name: CreatureAirTrap

buildingDefs.Name: <link="DESALINATOR">Desalinator</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: Salt can be refined into table salt for a mealtime morale boost.
buildingDefs.Effect: Removes <link="SALT">Salt</link> from <link="BRINE">Brine</link> or <link="SALTWATER">Salt Water</link>, producing <link="WATER">Water</link>.
buildingDefs.name: Desalinator

buildingDefs.Name: <link="INSULATEDDOOR">Insulated Door</link>
buildingDefs.Desc: A slow-moving door that works best when it's closed.
buildingDefs.Effect: Significantly reduces <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange between climate-controlled rooms.
buildingDefs.name: InsulatedDoor
